title: Quality Compliance Analyst
description:
**Quality Compliance Analyst**

Join NES Fircroft as a Quality Compliance Analyst and play a key role in supporting the delivery and continual improvement of our quality, compliance, and assurance activities. This is an excellent opportunity for a proactive and analytical professional to contribute to governance, accountability, performance insight, and continual improvement across the business. Working closely with stakeholders across multiple functions, you will help maintain our Integrated Management System, support compliance with ISO standards, and drive effective assurance and process improvement initiatives.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* **Quality & Compliance Support:**
  Provide coordination, administration, and operational support to the Quality & Data Protection team across quality, compliance, and assurance activities.
* **Audit Delivery:**
  Plan, conduct, and report on internal audits against defined criteria, including the Integrated Management System, identifying findings, risks, and improvement opportunities.
* **Corrective Action Management:**
  Record, monitor, and follow up on corrective and improvement actions, ensuring timely progression through to verified completion.
* **Data Analysis & Reporting:**
  Analyse quality and compliance information to identify trends, recurring issues, emerging risks, and opportunities to enhance business performance.
* **Supplier Assurance:**
  Support supplier audits, assessments, performance reviews, corrective action programmes, and improvement initiatives to evaluate effectiveness and manage risk.
* **Process Improvement:**
  Assist in reviewing and improving policies, procedures, controls, and working practices to promote consistency and operational efficiency.
* **Stakeholder Engagement:**
  Provide practical guidance and support to stakeholders, helping to increase awareness, ownership, and application of compliance requirements.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Work closely with Quality, Data Protection, Sustainability, Compliance, and other business functions to support shared objectives and priorities.
* **Governance & Compliance:**
  Contribute to initiatives that support legislative compliance, contractual obligations, governance frameworks, and adherence to ISO-based management systems.

**Why NES Fircroft**
At NES Fircroft, we are committed to maintaining high standards of quality, governance, and continual improvement across our global operations. We foster a collaborative environment where employees can contribute meaningful improvements, develop professionally, and make a real impact on business performance. This role offers the opportunity to work with diverse stakeholders, strengthen assurance activities, and support a culture of accountability and excellence.

**What We're Looking For**

* **ISO Knowledge:**
  Understanding of ISO Management Systems, ideally including ISO 9001.
* **Audit Experience:**
  Practical experience conducting internal audits against recognised ISO management system standards, with ISO 9001 auditing experience highly desirable.
* **Compliance Expertise:**
  Knowledge of audit principles, risk management, corrective actions, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* **Analytical Capability:**
  Proven experience analysing information, identifying trends, and producing meaningful reports.
* **Action Management:**
  Experience managing audit findings, corrective actions, and improvement activities through to completion.
* **Stakeholder Skills:**
  Ability to work effectively with stakeholders across multiple business functions.
* **Technical Proficiency:**
  Strong Microsoft Excel and Microsoft Office skills.
* **Communication Skills:**
  Excellent written, verbal, interpersonal, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* **Attention to Detail:**
  Strong organisational skills with a proactive and methodical approach to improving processes and controls.
* **Additional Advantage:**
  Experience with supplier audits, external certification audits, KPI reporting, dashboards, Power BI, or recruitment and professional services environments would be beneficial.
* **Professional Qualifications:**
  Internal Auditor or Lead Auditor qualifications and relevant quality or compliance-related qualifications are advantageous.

**Who Are We?**
NES Fircroft is a leading global workforce solutions provider, delivering specialist recruitment services across a range of technical and engineering sectors. Our success is built on expertise, trusted partnerships, and a commitment to delivering exceptional outcomes for clients, contractors, and candidates worldwide. We continue to invest in quality, innovation, and operational excellence to support sustainable growth and long-term success.

**Accessibility & Inclusion**
NES Fircroft is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with dignity and respect. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified individuals and are dedicated to providing reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process where required. We believe diverse perspectives strengthen our business and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.

About Us: https://www.nesfircroft.com

Meet The Team: https://www.nesfircroft.com/contact-us

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@NESFircroft

LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/nes-fircroft/

title: Staff Software Engineer – AI Native Builder, Legal & Privacy Technology
description:
**Overview**
Intuit is a mission-driven, global financial platform company that gives everyone the opportunity to prosper. With products like TurboTax, QuickBooks and Mint, we’re using technology to build solutions to challenging financial problems for millions of people around the world.
  
  
The FLP Tech - Legal and Privacy Technology team is the steward of Intuit's Legal and privacy solutions to provide scalable capabilities and experiences. Our mission is to that provide users with choices at time of need, honour their preferences, protects their rights, keeps Intuit and partners compliant. We are looking for an engineer with a strong background in system design and back-end (Java, Spring, REST/GraphQL services, etc.) and optionally in front-end web technologies (React JS) You will be part of a cross-functional team, working with a mix of business partners, developers, product managers and other analysts in an Agile Scrum team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Fullstack Engineering:**

* Ability to work effectively with developers and designers, discussing application and API architectures
* Leverage Agile methodologies and ability to manage 1 or more Scrum teams
* Capability level ownership in building, and supporting
* Collaborate closely with Senior Staff/Principal senior engineers across disciplines and build strong, supportive working relationships.
* Have good exposure on innovation methods like Design for Delight to experiment, iterate, and create impact.

**Other Responsibilities**

* Developing, maintaining, and innovating large scale, developer-facing platforms
* Familiar with security best practices
* Familiar with the development challenges inherent with adoption of API Gateway or Service Mesh platforms in large scale organizations
* Designing/developing web-based applications and backend services
* Gathering functional requirements, developing technical specifications, and project & test planning
* Act in a technical leadership capacity: Mentoring junior engineers, new team members, and applying technical expertise to challenging programming and design problems
* Resolve defects/bugs during testing, pre-production, production, and post-release patches
* Work cross-functionally with various Intuit teams: Product Management, Experience Design, various product lines, or business units to drive forward results
* Drive the design and architecture at the capability level

**Qualifications**

* 9+ years’ experience developing web applications
* BE/BTech in computer science or equivalent work experience
* Strong leadership experience: Leading meetings, presenting, technical go to person, and cross-functional collaborator.
* Expertise in the Software design/architecture process.
* Experience in some of the following technologies: RESTful or GraphQL based web services with Java, Spring Boot, Dynamo DB, React JS, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, Python, Camunda
* Understanding with AWS skill - S3, SQS, KMS, Lambda, RDS, App Stream etc.
* Experience with unit testing & Test Driven Development (TDD)
* Experience in the Domain driven design and hexagonal architecture
* Experience with Agile Development, SCRUM, or Extreme Programming methodologies
* Solid communication skills: Demonstrated ability to explain complex technical issues to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Strong understanding of the software design/architecture process
* Good to have : Working/hands on experience building privacy solutions for company
* "Self-starter" attitude with a willingness to dive in and figure things out
* Experience with leveraging, contributing to and leading open source community projects.
* Strategic and analytical thinker who is hypothesis-driven and uses data, judgment, and pattern recognition for learning and moving quickly
* Excellent communication and presentation skills: Demonstrated ability to explain complex issues to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Experience working with Kubernetes/Docker

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

title: RC - REGULATORY COMPLIANCE - Lab Digitisation - CA - Labware - Staff
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- GDS Consulting –**
**Enterprise Risk (ER) – Regulatory Compliance**
**–Staff – Labs – Configuration Analyst**
As part of our EY-ER- Regulatory Compliance team, you will help the clients by understanding their business needs and delivering solutions in accordance with the EY guidelines & methodologies. As a Regulatory Compliance senior actively establish, maintain and strengthen internal and external relationships. In line with our commitment to quality, you’ll consistently drive projects to completion with high quality deliverables, achieve operational efficiency, proactively identify and raise risks with the client as well as EY senior management team and lead internal initiatives.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for Staff with expertise in LIMS Implementations & Configurations for Life Sciences industries to join our EY-Regulatory Compliance team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of emerging service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Work closely with business stakeholders, laboratory personnel, and IT teams to gather and document LIMS requirements.
* Gather and analyse business requirements related to LIMS functionality and enhancements.
* Configure and customize LIMS platforms (Preferably LabWare, Labvantage) to support end-to-end laboratory workflows including sample lifecycle management, testing, stability studies, and reporting.
* Design and implement master data, workflows, and business rules (e.g., specifications, test methods, instruments, calculations) aligned with GxP requirements and regulatory standards.
* Develop integrations and data interfaces between LIMS and enterprise systems (e.g., CDS, ELN, ERP, MES) using APIs, middleware, or flat-file exchanges to enable seamless data flow.
* Support validation and compliance activities by preparing configuration documentation, executing IQ/OQ/PQ, and ensuring adherence to 21 CFR Part 11, ALCOA+ data integrity principles.
* Troubleshoot and optimize system performance by resolving configuration issues, enhancing usability, and driving continuous improvement initiatives across laboratory operations.
* Partner with clients to understand laboratory operations and translate business and compliance requirements into integrated digital lab solutions and their respective configurations
* Drive requirements gathering, system configuration, data migration, and integrations across lab systems, instruments, and enterprise platforms
* Ensure data integrity, traceability, and compliance with GxP, 21 CFR Part 11, Annex 11, and internal SOPs
* Work with laboratory teams to ensure LIMS supports laboratory practices, procedures, and workflows effectively.
* Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement within laboratory operations using LIMS.
* Drive and support LIMS enhancements and process improvements across global sites as required.

**Master Data Design Configuration**

* Analyse the Technical documents such as SOP/STP/Monograms/Pharmacopeial references and convert them into LIMS compatible data sets.
* Configure master data elements such as test methods, sample types, specifications, workflows, and stability studies within LIMS.
* Maintain data integrity, consistency, and version control across the system.
* Implement changes and updates to LIMS master data in alignment with business and regulatory needs.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure accurate data migration and system integration.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to master data configuration and system functionality.
* Work on optimizing data structures and database management within LIMS.
* Configure and onboard new laboratory instruments, including both file-based instrument integrations and direct instrument connections.
* Support Microbiology Method Execution processes through LIMS configuration and master data maintenance.

**Application Support**

* Develop, customize, and implement LIMS applications to meet laboratory and business requirements.
* Configure, extend, and support LabWare LIMS, LabVantage LIMS, and other LIMS platforms.
* Integrate LIMS with other enterprise systems such as ERP, ELN, CDS, MES, and laboratory instrumentation software.
* Design and optimize databases for efficient storage and retrieval of laboratory data.
* Develop and maintain system interfaces, workflows, and automation scripts to streamline laboratory processes.
* Provide technical support, troubleshooting, and bug fixes for LIMS applications, ensuring minimal downtime.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of laboratory workflows, sample lifecycle management, and data integrity principles.
* Familiarity with analytical techniques, laboratory instrumentation, and regulatory standards.
* Exposure to Good Laboratory Practices (GLP), Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), and ISO 17025 compliance.
* Experience in working with scientific and analytical teams to align LIMS functionality with laboratory operations.
* Understanding of quality control, stability studies, environmental monitoring, and batch release processes within laboratories.
* Proficiency in LIMS software (e.g., LabWare, LabVantage, STARLIMS, SampleManager, or similar platforms).
* Knowledge of system integration with ERP, MES, or other enterprise applications.
* Previous experience as a Business Analyst or System Administrator or Master Data Manager working with LIMS.
* Hands-on experience in master data configuration within LIMS platforms.
* Experience in system validation, testing, and documentation.
* Exposure to Enterprise IT applications like LIMS, SAP, ELN, MES, Documentum, TrackWise, Veeva Vault, ValGenesis, etc in pharmaceutical organization
* Understanding of relational databases and SQL queries.
* Experience with scripting or automation tools for LIMS is a plus.
* Understanding of API integrations, web services, and middleware solutions for LIMS.
* Ability to troubleshoot system and data issues efficiently.
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data integrity.
* Adaptability to dynamic business and regulatory environments.
* Demonstrated track record in project management, governance, and reporting
* Exposure to Data Integrity requirements and other applicable regulations
* Knowledge of Incident Management, Change Management.
* Prior experience of supporting Audits / Inspections

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* B.E/B.Tech (Comp. Science/ Life Sciences/Chemistry/Information Technology or a related field)/Postgraduate in Science (Preferably in Chemistry/Biochemistry) with 2+ years of experience with Big 4 or Multi-National Regulatory Compliance companies or Leading Life sciences / Pharmaceutical Industries.
* Good interpersonal skills; Good written, oral and presentation skills
* Consulting or client‑facing experience preferred.
* Excellent communication, documentation, and stakeholder management skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Information Security (ISO 27001) or Risk Management certifications
* LIMS admin certification or Equivalent
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM) or Equivalent (Preferred but not required).

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment with consulting skills.
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 1400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Consulting practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: AML QA Specialist, Swedish, Account Compliance Quality
description:
**Description**
The Compliance Quality team is looking for a Swedish speaking quality control specialist to join a team of quality specialists covering the Know Your Customers program. The role is critical to ensure that Amazon’s payments businesses expand with appropriate controls and quality processes in place, minimizing risks and identifying opportunities for process improvement.
  
  
This quality control specialist role will join a team, who are responsible for auditing and reporting of "high-complexity" AML operational work across Amazon's payment entities and licenses. The Account Compliance Quality Auditor will work closely with operations teams and the AML program teams (both first line of defense teams) as well as occasionally with the compliance officers of the various entities (second line of defense).
  
  
The role will require performing AML quality audits on behalf of the Account Compliance Quality team, as well as delivering coaching and training to the operations teams.
  
  
The quality control specialist will be an independent individual contributor, with effective problem-solving skills.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Perform AML quality audits on behalf of the Quality Assurance Team.
* Partner with operational teams to deliver quality findings and support ongoing improvement opportunities.
* Provide AML quality audit subject matter expertise to business and operations teams during meetings, workshops, and leadership reviews.
* Create and update guidance and program documents.
* Conduct a variety of investigation and audit types including suspicious activity, sanctions, and enhanced due diligence.
* Share industry expertise through audits and provide written, professional feedback.
* Apply an analytical and detailed thought process to various product types and services within an AML construct.
* Assist with linking policies, standard operating procedures, internal controls, monitoring, and reporting with the goal of improving operations, compliance policies, and risk management

**Basic Qualifications**

* 2+ years of previous AML or Compliance experience
* Knowledge of compliance, EU AML and KYC-related laws, and other relevant regulations
* Experience communicating clearly and concisely with leadership, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent in a related field
* Professional auditing qualification, or similar risk or compliance credentials
* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
* Speak, write, and read fluently in Swedish
* Experience handling confidential information

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Professional certification such as CAMS, CRCM, or CRP
* Language certification from internationally recognised institution
* Master's degree in Compliance, Risk or Business

description:
Contracts Management – Job Description

Role - Contracts Administrator 2-Fin

A
**Contracts Manager**
is responsible for overseeing the entire lifecycle of an organization's contracts acting as a fiduciary ensuring legal compliance, mitigating risks, and maximizing financial and operational performance. This role requires a blend of knowledge on contracts language, business acumen, and strong project management skills. Legal knowledge although not mandatory is beneficial.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Contract Lifecycle Management:**
  Manage the entire contract process from initial request and authoring through execution, performance monitoring, renewal, or termination.
* **Compliance and Risk Management:**
  Ensure all parties adhere to contract terms and conditions, monitor adherence to federal, state, and local laws, and identify and mitigate potential legal, financial, and operational risks. Strict adherence internal contract management policies and procedures
* **Stakeholder Collaboration:**
  Serve as the primary liaison between internal teams (legal, AR, reporting, collections, process owners, business practice and approvers) and Sales to ensure mutual understanding and agreement on contract terms.
* **Q management:**
  Ensure all contractual records and correspondence are attached in the Q system for efficiency and easy retrieval and allowing for continuity
* **Dispute Resolution:**
  Address and resolve any contract-related issues, conflicts, or breaches in a timely and professional manner to avoid litigation and maintain positive relationships.
* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Proactively identify and analyze areas for process optimization, operational efficiency, and service quality enhancements. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement best practices and innovative solutions. Track the effectiveness of improvement initiatives through data-driven metrics. Additionally, possessing practical knowledge of crafting and leveraging AI prompts to support automation, workflow enhancement, and informed decision-making

**Qualifications and Skills**

* **Education:**
  Typically a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, or a related field; some positions may require a Master's degree or professional certification (e.g., Certified Commercial Contracts Manager is a bonus).
* **Experience:**
  Previous experience in contract management, negotiation, or a related field (typically 5+ years).
* **Legal Knowledge:**
  A strong understanding of contract law principles and legal terminology.
* **Attention to Detail:**
  Meticulous attention to detail to spot errors or ambiguous clauses in complex documents.
* **Communication Skills:**
  Excellent written and verbal communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with diverse stakeholders.
* **Organizational and Time Management Skills:**
  The ability to manage multiple contracts and deadlines simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* **Technical Proficiency:**
  Experience with programs (Microsoft Office Suite, primarily excel).

title: Privacy Consultant
description:
**Job Title:**
Privacy Consultant

**Location:**
Bengaluru

**Experience:**
2 to 4 Years

**Department:**
Advisory

**About Us:**

AuthenticOne is a CERT-In empanelled and CREST Accredited Cybersecurity solutions and services company with expertise in consulting, advisory and risk management. AuthenticOne specializes in Comprehensive Compliance Management, Vulnerability Assessment, Penetration Testing, and Managed Security Services. Our expert team ensures that clients' businesses meet all regulatory requirements, identify and mitigate potential vulnerabilities, and maintain robust, continuous protection against evolving cyber threats.

**Position Summary:**

We’re building one of India’s leading privacy practices. Come build it with us. As a Privacy Consultant, you will help clients across BFSI, healthcare, SaaS/technology, and manufacturing comply with DPDPA, GDPR, and other privacy regulations - from assessing data practices and closing gaps to building privacy programs aligned with their security and GRC frameworks. A client-facing role with real ownership and room to grow.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Privacy Assessments: Lead data discovery and mapping exercises, maintain RoPA, and conduct DPIAs, privacy gap assessments, and audits for client organisations.
* Regulatory Advisory: Interpret DPDPA, DPDP Rules, GDPR, and other applicable laws, and translate them into clear, practical actions for clients.
* Regulatory Tracking: Keep clients ahead of new rules, regulator guidance, and enforcement trends, and adjust their compliance roadmaps as requirements evolve.
* Privacy Program Implementation: Help clients design and roll out privacy policies, notices, consent processes, retention schedules, and governance structures.
* Rights & Breach Management: Set up processes for handling data principal requests and support clients in preparing for and responding to personal data breaches.
* Vendor Privacy Risk: Assess processors and third parties, review data processing agreements, and advise on cross-border data transfers.
* GRC Integration: Align privacy controls with ISO 27001, ISO 27701, and sector requirements such as RBI and SEBI guidelines.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work with client Legal, IT, Security, Product, and business teams to embed privacy into everyday operations.
* Reporting & Delivery: Prepare assessment reports, presentations, and documentation, and support end-to-end project delivery.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 2 to 4 years of hands-on experience in data privacy, privacy consulting, or GRC roles with a privacy focus.
* Good working knowledge of DPDPA and GDPR; exposure to CCPA/CPRA, PDPL, or other global privacy laws is a plus.
* Has delivered at least one end-to-end privacy assessment or DPDPA/GDPR readiness engagement.
* Familiarity with how privacy controls map to ISO 27001, ISO 27701, and sector regulations such as RBI and SEBI.
* Strong analytical, documentation, and client-facing communication skills.
* Ability to handle multiple engagements and deliverables independently is a plus.
* Certifications such as CIPP/E, CIPM, DSCI DCPP, or ISO 27701 Lead Implementer/Auditor are preferred.

**Why Join Us**

* Be part of a young, passionate cybersecurity company making a real impact.
* Work directly with leadership and sales experts and fast-track your learning.
* Sell with a modern, automation-first sales stack, backed by a rare CERT-In + CREST dual accreditation.
* A culture built on Simplicity, Excellence, Trust and Customer Centricity.

Job Summary

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive
**Contracts Associate**
to join our Legal team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and managing a wide range of commercial and business agreements, ensuring contractual compliance, mitigating legal and commercial risks, and providing timely legal support to various business functions.

Key Responsibilities

* **Contract Drafting and Review:**
  Draft, review, vet, and negotiate various types of agreements, including vendor and supplier agreements, service agreements, non-disclosure agreements (NDAs), consultancy agreements, distribution agreements, purchase agreements, and other commercial contracts.
* **Contract Risk Management:**
  Identify potential legal and commercial risks in contractual terms and recommend appropriate modifications to protect the Company's interests.
* **Contract Negotiation:**
  Work closely with internal stakeholders and external parties to negotiate contractual terms, resolve legal issues, and facilitate timely execution of agreements.
* **Standardization of Contracts:**
  Develop, review, and maintain standard contract templates, clauses, and legal documentation to ensure consistency and compliance with applicable laws and Company policies.
* **Contract Lifecycle Management:**
  Manage contracts throughout their lifecycle, including drafting, review, approval, execution, renewal, amendment, and termination.
* **Legal Advisory:**
  Provide practical legal advice on contractual obligations, interpretation of clauses, indemnities, limitation of liability, warranties, confidentiality, termination, and dispute resolution.
* **Stakeholder Coordination:**
  Collaborate with internal departments, including Procurement, Sales, Finance, HR, and Business Development, to address contractual requirements and facilitate business operations.
* **Dispute Management:**
  Assist in handling contractual disputes, claims, notices, and other legal issues arising from commercial agreements, in coordination with external counsel where required.
* **Compliance and Legal Research:**
  Conduct legal research and provide opinions on contractual matters, applicable laws, regulatory requirements, and emerging legal developments relevant to the business.
* **Contract Documentation and MIS:**
  Maintain an organized contract repository, track contractual obligations, renewal dates, and key milestones, and prepare periodic reports and MIS for the Legal department.

Required Qualifications and Skills

* LL.B. degree from a recognized university.
* 4–7 years of relevant experience in contracts management, commercial law, or an in-house legal department.
* Strong expertise in drafting, reviewing, vetting, and negotiating commercial and business agreements.
* Good understanding of contractual risk assessment, indemnification, liability provisions, warranties, confidentiality, and dispute resolution clauses.
* Ability to interpret legal provisions and translate legal requirements into practical business advice.
* Strong written and verbal communication, negotiation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple contracts and priorities simultaneously.
* Proficiency in maintaining contract records, legal documentation, and MIS reports.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and manage deadlines effectively.

Preferred Skills

* Prior experience in a corporate or in-house legal environment.
* Familiarity with contract lifecycle management systems and digital document repositories.
* Experience in developing standardized contract templates and improving contract management processes.



**How to Apply:**
Interested candidates who meet the above requirements are invited to share their updated CV at hr@emergelegal.co.in.

title: Senior Data Privacy Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
**About Us**
:
  
  
Tsaaro is dedicated to Data Privacy and Security as its core focus. Our team comprises specialized data privacy consultants, information security experts, and penetration testers, all working to empower our clients with seamless and highly efficient security solutions. Our approach is centered around customization, understanding the unique needs of each organization, and finding solutions that align with their budget and resource constraints.
  
  
At Tsaaro, we adopt a pragmatic, risk-based strategy to deliver practical and effective advice. By providing real-world guidance, support, and actionable recommendations, we confidently equip our clients to address a broad spectrum of security and privacy challenges.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As a Senior Data Privacy Consultant, you will be entrusted with the following key responsibilities:
  
  

* Design and implement data protection and privacy programs that cater to our clients' specific business needs, ensuring their sensitive information is well safeguarded.
* Evaluate and assess our clients' data protection and privacy practices, offering valuable insights and actionable recommendations for continual improvement.
* Demonstrate expertise in various standards, such as ISO 27001/2, ISO 22301, ISO 27018, NIST standards on Cyber Security, HITRUST, ISO 27701, etc., to assist clients in compliance and governance.
* Provide guidance and support to clients in adhering to a complex web of national and international laws and regulations, including the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and other privacy laws.
* Assist in preparing policies, reports, and schedules for clients and relevant stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and alignment with industry best practices.
* Conduct thorough audits of Privacy controls to monitor program effectiveness and compliance, ensuring data protection is at its optimal level.
* Utilize online tools to facilitate Incident Management and Data Subject Rights processes, ensuring efficient and timely responses to potential data incidents.
* Foster and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel, promoting effective collaboration and understanding of their specific needs.
* Demonstrate a strong commitment to adhering to workplace policies and procedures, maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and confidentiality.
* Contribute to cybersecurity engagements, developing cybersecurity strategies, governance, risk, and compliance activities, and cybersecurity policies in line with ISO 27001 and ISO 27701.
* Perform Gap Assessments, Risk Assessments, ISMS Documentation, Internal Audits, and support during Certification Audits to strengthen overall security frameworks.

**Requirements**
To be considered for this role, the candidate must meet the following requirements:
  
  

* Possess a sound knowledge of fundamentals of information security systems.
* Have 2-3 years of relevant experience in the field.
* Demonstrate proficiency in standards such as ISO 27001/2, ISO 22301, ISO 27018, NIST standards on Cyber Security, HITRUST, ISO 27701, etc.
* Exhibit a good understanding of GDPR, CCPA, or other privacy laws.
* Display competence in governance and reporting, as well as a strong grasp of cyber and privacy risks.
* Hold relevant qualifications such as CIPM, CIPT, CIPP/E.
* Showcase excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
* Professional development opportunities, including training and certifications.
* Flexible working hours.
* Collaborative and inclusive work environment.
* Opportunity to work with a passionate team dedicated to making a difference in data privacy and security.

title: Software Asset and (SAP S/4) License Manager
description:
**About Signify**
Through bold discovery and cutting-edge innovation, we lead an industry that is vital for the future of our planet: lighting. Through our leadership in connected lighting and the Internet of Things, we're breaking new ground in data analytics, AI, and smart solutions for homes, offices, cities, and beyond.
  
  
At Signify, you can shape tomorrow by building on our incredible 125+ year legacy while working toward even bolder sustainability goals. Our culture of continuous learning, creativity, and commitment to diversity and inclusion empowers you to grow your skills and career.
  
  
Join us, and together, we’ll transform our industry, making a lasting difference for brighter lives and a better world.
  
  
**Position Summary**
**More about the role**
The Software Asset & SAP License Manager is responsible for the governance, optimization, financial control, and compliance of the organization's enterprise software portfolio, with a primary focus on SAP S/4HANA RISE subscriptions in a multinational environment.
  
  
This role ensures that SAP subscriptions are contracted correctly, licenses are allocated efficiently, invoices are validated accurately, and contractual entitlements are fully leveraged to optimize software spending while maintaining compliance. The position acts as the primary expert on SAP commercial models, subscription metrics, credits, and licensing rules, working closely with Procurement, Finance, IT, Enterprise Architecture, SAP Basis, Business Process Owners, and SAP account teams.
  
  
The role combines software asset management, commercial contract management, financial analysis, and vendor governance to maximize value from the organization's SAP investment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**SAP Subscription & License Management**

* Own the lifecycle management of SAP S/4HANA RISE subscriptions across all business entities and countries.
* Maintain an accurate inventory of SAP subscriptions, entitlements, cloud services, users, and license assignments.
* Monitor license consumption and identify optimization opportunities before additional subscriptions are required.
* Ensure subscription allocations align with business demand and organizational changes.
* Develop and maintain governance processes for ongoing license management.

**Contract & Commercial Governance**

* Serve as the organization's subject matter expert on SAP commercial models and subscription agreements.
* Interpret SAP RISE contracts, ordering documents, pricing schedules, and commercial terms.
* Ensure contracted services accurately reflect business requirements.
* Assess the commercial impact of organizational changes, acquisitions, divestitures, and new projects.
* Support contract renewals, amendments, and negotiations by providing commercial and licensing expertise.
* Identify contractual rights and mechanisms that can reduce costs or improve commercial flexibility.

**SAP RISE Expertise**
**Develop Deep Expertise In SAP RISE Commercial Concepts, Including**

* Full User Equivalent (FUE) licensing
* Subscription metrics
* Consumption-based services
* Cloud credits
* SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) entitlements
* Included cloud services
* Digital access considerations
* Hyperscaler-related commercial components
* Migration and transition rights
* License conversion programs
* Flexibility mechanisms within SAP agreements

Advise stakeholders on how these components influence licensing strategy and cost optimization.
  
  
**Invoice Validation & Financial Control**

* Review and validate all SAP invoices before payment.
* Verify that invoiced subscriptions match contractual agreements and pricing schedules.
* Reconcile invoices against:

+ contracted subscriptions
+ agreed pricing
+ applicable discounts
+ credits
+ true-ups
+ service changes
+ consumption reports

* Identify billing discrepancies and coordinate corrections with SAP.
* Ensure credits and contractual adjustments are correctly applied.
* Build financial reporting on SAP software spend across the global organization.

**Software Asset Management**

* Maintain compliance with software asset management policies.
* Establish governance processes for software request, allocation, reassignment, and retirement.
* Monitor software usage to reduce unused or underutilized subscriptions.
* Produce regular compliance and optimization reports.
* Prepare the organization for internal and external software audits.

**Cost Optimization**

* Continuously identify opportunities to reduce SAP licensing and subscription costs.
* Analyze license utilization patterns and recommend consolidation or reassignment.
* Maximize use of contractual entitlements before recommending new purchases.
* Support budgeting and forecasting of SAP software costs.
* Develop optimization strategies that balance business requirements with commercial efficiency.

**Vendor & Stakeholder Management**

* Act as the primary interface between the organization and SAP regarding licensing and subscription management.
* Collaborate with Procurement during negotiations and renewals.
* Work closely with Finance on budgeting, accruals, invoice validation, and financial reporting.
* Partner with IT teams to understand system usage and future demand.
* Present licensing risks, opportunities, and recommendations to senior management.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Business Administration, Finance, Procurement, or a related field.
* 5–10 years of experience in Software Asset Management (SAM), IT Asset Management (ITAM), SAP licensing, or enterprise software contract management.
* Proven experience managing SAP enterprise agreements within multinational organizations.
* Strong understanding of SAP S/4HANA RISE subscription models.
* Experience interpreting complex software contracts and commercial agreements.
* Experience validating enterprise software invoices and subscription billing.
* Strong analytical and financial skills.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel and reporting skills.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication abilities.
* Fluency in English.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP).
* Knowledge of SAP cloud commercial models.
* Experience with software asset management tools (e.g., Flexera, Snow Software, ServiceNow SAM Pro, USU, or similar platforms).
* Familiarity with ITIL and IT asset management frameworks.
* Experience supporting SAP audits or licensing reviews.
* Certification in Software Asset Management (IAITAM, ITAM Forum, or equivalent) is advantageous.
* SAP licensing or procurement certifications are considered a plus.

**Key Competencies**

* SAP licensing expertise
* Commercial contract analysis
* Financial acumen
* Invoice validation
* Cost optimization
* Vendor management
* Negotiation support
* Risk management
* Attention to detail
* Data analysis
* Strategic thinking
* Stakeholder management
* Process improvement
* Governance and compliance

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* SAP invoice accuracy and billing discrepancy resolution
* Annual SAP software cost savings
* License utilization and optimization rate
* Compliance with contractual entitlements
* Reduction of unused subscriptions
* Successful completion of software audits
* Forecast accuracy for SAP software spend
* Timely identification and application of contractual credits and entitlements
* Value realized through contract optimization initiatives

**Everything we’ll do for you**
You can grow a lasting career here. We’ll encourage you, support you, and challenge you. We’ll help you learn and progress in a way that’s right for you, with coaching and mentoring along the way. We’ll listen to you too, because we see and value every one of our 27,000+ people. We believe that a diverse and inclusive workplace fosters creativity, innovation, and a full spectrum of bright ideas. With a global workforce present in 70+ countries, we are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment where every voice is heard and valued, helping us all achieve more together.
  
  
Come join us, and together we can light up the future.

title: AVP, Legal
description:
**About Revantage**
Revantage, a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company, is a global provider of corporate services.
  
  
With a corporate purpose of ‘In Pursuit of Better,’ Revantage delivers value-added services and world-class talent for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, spanning diverse asset classes, including residential, logistics, office, hospitality and retail sectors. The company’s footprint extends across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific.
  
  
Creating a culture that inspires impact and momentum requires the right team. We know what it takes to lead an industry, and are looking for leaders who seek constant growth, want to excel, and continuously improve upon themselves and the industry.
  
  
In addition to supporting Revantage, we also recruit for Blackstone Real Estate portfolio companies, giving you the unique opportunity to work within a network of best-in-class professionals across a broad real estate platform.
  
  
**India**
With offices in Bengaluru and Gurugram, our teams in India deliver expertise, innovation and operational excellence that support thousands of assets across logistics, data centers, residential, commercial and hospitality.
  
  
Whether you’re building new capabilities, driving critical initiatives or strengthening partnerships, you’ll have the opportunity to truly
**Build What Matters.**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a AVP legal for American Campus Communities (ACC), a Blackstone Real Estate portfolio company and the largest owner, manager and developer of high-quality student housing communities in the United States. This role is based in Bengaluru, India, is hired through Revantage India and reports to ACC’s General Counsel.
  
  
The role provides substantive legal support across commercial contracts, property operations, regulatory matters and corporate governance, while supporting privacy, litigation, insurance and risk matters. Working closely with the General Counsel, other US-based attorneys and senior business stakeholders, the role will manage manage a broad range of recurring legal matters, apply sound legal judgment and provide practical, business-oriented legal support within established areas of authority.
  
  
The role serves as a senior extension of ACC’s US-based Legal Department, with responsibility for drafting and negotiating commercial agreements, supporting property and resident matters, monitoring legal and regulatory developments, maintaining corporate entity records and helping drive matters from intake through resolution. The position requires strong legal judgment, drafting and negotiation capability, organizational discipline and the ability to distinguish matters that can be handled independently from those requiring escalation to the General Counsel or other US-based Legal leadership.
  
  
**Primary Role**

* Draft, review and negotiate vendor agreements, service agreements, consulting agreements, confidentiality agreements, access agreements and other commercial contracts, independently resolving routine terms within established playbooks and escalating material legal or business issues as appropriate.
* Advise on contract interpretation, amendments, extensions, renewals, termination provisions and contractual matters, supporting business teams in resolving routine contract-related issues.
* Develop, draft and maintain standard contract forms, templates and playbooks, identify recurring negotiation issues and recommend improvements to contracting standards and processes.
* Provide legal guidance on landlord-tenant requirements, leasing practices, eviction requirements and other legal matters routinely affecting property operations
* Provide and/or oversee the research, monitoring, applicability and interpretation of federal, state and local laws and regulations affecting key areas of ACC’s business; analyze potential implications of changes in laws and regulatory requirements and propose necessary changes to ACC’s policies and operations, as applicable; communicate relevant developments and recommended actions to Legal and business stakeholders.
* Recommend, draft and support updates to agreements, forms, policies, procedures and operating practices in response to changes in applicable law or identified legal risks.
* Maintain oversight of ACC’s corporate entity files and organizational records, including formation documents, operating agreements, amendments, registrations and other entity-related documentation, ensuring records are current, complete and appropriately controlled.
* Support the maintenance, development and documentation of corporate governance matters.
* Provide substantive legal support for privacy, litigation, insurance claims and risk matters as needed, including legal research, document review, issue analysis, case or claim summaries and coordination with outside counsel and internal stakeholders.
* Support the GC and US-based Legal team in evaluating and managing significant legal matters, identifying key facts, legal issues, risks, deadlines and recommended paths forward.
* Coordinate with outside counsel and other legal service providers on assigned matters, monitor progress and deliverables, and help ensure efficient use of external legal resources.
* Partner directly with property operations, Asset Management, Finance, Accounting, Human Resources, Risk, Information Security and other business functions to provide practical legal support and facilitate resolution of assigned matters.
* Maintain high-quality legal documentation, matter files and supporting records, ensuring appropriate confidentiality, privilege, version control and follow-through from initial assignment through completion.
* Exercise independent judgment within established areas of responsibility, proactively identify legal and business risks, and escalate significant, novel or high-risk matters to the General Counsel or other US-based Legal leadership.
* Identify and drive improvements to legal processes, contracting workflows, knowledge management and technology utilization, including opportunities to standardize work and leverage AI and other legal tools.
* Work from the Bengaluru office under the hybrid working model, with working hours aligned to provide meaningful daily overlap with US business hours; flexibility is expected for time-sensitive legal matters and other peak periods.
* Oversee the work and performance of junior attorney(s) on the Bengaluru legal team
* Perform other legal, regulatory and strategic projects and responsibilities as assigned

**Qualifications & Skills**

* JD, LL.B. or equivalent law degree is required; admission to practice law in the candidate’s home jurisdiction is preferred.
* Eight or more years of relevant legal experience, including meaningful experience supporting US corporate, commercial, real estate or operating-company matters.
* Strong commercial contracting experience, including demonstrated ability to independently draft, review and negotiate vendor, service, consulting, confidentiality and other business agreements.
* Demonstrated ability to apply legal judgment to operational matters, identify material legal and business risks and develop practical solutions within established areas of authority.
* Strong knowledge of legal research and regulatory analysis, with the ability to interpret statutes, regulations and other requirements across multiple US jurisdictions and translate them into practical business guidance.
* Strong legal drafting and writing skills, with the ability to prepare agreements, legal analyses, executive summaries and other work product requiring limited revision.
* Experience supporting landlord-tenant, real estate operations or other multi-jurisdiction operating matters is preferred.
* Experience maintaining corporate entity records, organizational documents and governance-related materials is preferred.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex or incomplete fact patterns, identify key legal issues and determine when escalation is appropriate.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage multiple substantive matters from intake through resolution while maintaining appropriate communication with senior Legal leadership.
* Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with senior business leaders, attorneys, outside counsel and other parties across functions and time zones.
* High degree of professional judgment, discretion and confidentiality when handling sensitive, privileged or business-critical matters.
* Experience with legal research databases, contract or matter-management systems, document-management tools and technology-assisted legal workflows is preferred.
* Experience supporting a US real estate company, property management company, corporate legal department or law firm is strongly preferred.
* Experience in one or more of commercial contracts, landlord-tenant law, regulatory compliance, corporate governance, privacy, litigation or insurance and risk management is preferred.

**About the role**

The intern will work closely with the Legal Counsel and assist across the legal function. This is a hands-on role with exposure to live commercial, corporate, regulatory, data protection and dispute resolution matters. You will work with business, finance, product, HR and other teams and get a practical view of how an in-house legal function operates.

• Assist in drafting and updating internal policies, compliance process notes.

• Support internal legal and compliance reviews to identify gaps and recommend practical corrective measures.

• Track developments in corporate governance, data protection and sector-specific regulations and assess their relevance to the business.

**5. Corporate and Secretarial :**

• Assist with corporate and governance-related legal matters, including preparation and review of relevant documentation and resolutions.

• Support legal review of proposed corporate actions and transactions from a governance and documentation perspective.

**6. Data Privacy Compliance :**

• Support DPDP Act implementation, including gap analysis, data mapping, data-sharing and vendor-assessment SOPs, privacy policies and consent flows.

• Work closely with product and tech teams to implement the DPDP Act framework.

**7. Operational & Administrative Legal Support :**

• Maintain legal records, contracts, and litigation trackers.

• Streamline legal operations to improve efficiency in contract approvals, escalations, and risk management.

• Provide advisory and support to internal teams on key legal and compliance issues.

•
**Ownership:**
Take responsibility for assigned matters and drive them to closure rather than waiting for instructions at every step.

•
**Language Preference: Proficiency in Kannada, along with English, will be an added advantage.**

•
**Education:**
Must have completed an
**LLB degree from a recognised university.**

Judgment: Know when to dig deeper, flag a risk, ask the right question or escalate an issue.

•
**Execution:**
Be comfortable working on live matters, managing multiple priorities and meeting timelines.

•
**Attention to detai**
l: Spot inconsistencies, missing information and potential legal or commercial issues before they become problems.

•
**Business mindset:**
Understand that in-house legal work is about enabling the business while managing risk, not just identifying what cannot be done.

•
**Collaboration:**
Work effectively with business, finance, HR, product, technology and other teams.

•
**Confidentiality**
: Handle sensitive business, employee, customer and legal information with discretion and professionalism.

You won’t be limited to research or back-end documentation. You’ll get to work on live negotiations, business deals, regulatory questions, disputes, corporate matters and privacy implementation, and see how legal advice is actually translated into business decisions.

description:

**Job Description**
**Job Summary**
We are looking for an experienced Compliance Manager to oversee statutory and labour law compliance across multiple client sites. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring adherence to applicable labour laws, statutory regulations, client requirements, and internal compliance policies. The role involves coordinating with HR, payroll, operations, vendors, and government authorities to ensure timely submissions, accurate documentation, and compliance readiness across all locations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Statutory and Labour Law Compliance
* Ensure compliance with applicable labour laws, statutory regulations, and government requirements.
* Monitor compliance requirements relating to PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, minimum wages, bonus, gratuity, and other applicable statutory obligations.
* Track changes in labour laws and communicate relevant updates to management and concerned teams.
* Ensure timely filing of statutory returns, remittances, and other mandatory submissions.
* Multi-Site Compliance Management
* Monitor statutory compliance across multiple client locations and operational sites.
* Ensure vendors and contractors comply with applicable statutory requirements.
* Verify statutory registrations, licences, and other mandatory documents for client sites.
* Maintain compliance trackers and ensure timely closure of pending observations.
* Audit and Documentation
* Coordinate internal, external, client, and statutory audits.
* Maintain statutory registers, records, returns, challans, wage registers, and other compliance documents.
* Conduct periodic compliance audits and identify gaps or non-compliance issues.
* Prepare audit reports and ensure corrective and preventive actions are implemented within agreed timelines.
* Payroll and Wage Compliance
* Review payroll-related statutory deductions and contributions, including PF, ESIC, and Professional Tax, as applicable.
* Verify minimum wage compliance, overtime payments, leave records, and wage disbursement documentation.
* Coordinate with payroll and finance teams to resolve discrepancies and ensure accurate statutory payments.
* Contractor and Vendor Compliance
* Review contractor compliance documents, including licences, registrations, wage records, attendance, and statutory payment proofs.
* Monitor compliance with applicable contract labour and other relevant employment regulations.
* Follow up with vendors for missing documents and ensure timely submission of compliance records.
* Risk Management and Reporting
* Identify compliance risks and recommend corrective measures.
* Maintain a compliance calendar and ensure deadlines are met.
* Escalate critical compliance gaps to senior management.
* Prepare monthly compliance dashboards, audit status reports, and management updates.
* Stakeholder Coordination
* Work closely with HR, payroll, finance, procurement, operations, and client teams.
* Coordinate with labour authorities, auditors, and external consultants, wherever required.
* Provide guidance to site teams on statutory compliance requirements and documentation.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Law, Commerce, Business Administration, Human Resources, or a related field.
* Relevant certification or qualification in labour law and statutory compliance will be an advantage.
* Strong knowledge of applicable Indian labour laws and statutory compliance requirements.

**Required Skills And Experience**

* 8–12 years of relevant experience in statutory compliance, preferably in facility management, integrated facilities management, or multi-site operations.
* Good understanding of PF, ESIC, minimum wages, Professional Tax, bonus, gratuity, contract labour compliance, and payroll statutory requirements.
* Experience in handling compliance for multiple locations and large workforces.
* Strong audit management, documentation, analytical, and reporting skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and compliance management systems.
* Strong communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.

Additional Information
  
  

* Precision-driven, analytical, and detail-focused.
* Able to navigate complex, high-compliance environments.
* Excellent planning, controls, and documentation capabilities.

title: Senior Specialist-Paralegal (OHS)
description:
**Fresenius Medical Care**
is the premier health care company focused on delivering the highest quality of care to people with renal and other chronic conditions. Through our industry-leading global network of more than 3,400 dialysis clinics and acute care canters, outpatient cardiac and vascular labs, Fresenius Medical Care provides coordinated health care services at pivotal care points for hundreds of thousands of chronically ill patients. As the world’s only vertically integrated renal company, we also offer specialty pharmacy and laboratory services, as well as manufacturing and distributing the most comprehensive line of dialysis equipment, disposable products and renal pharmaceuticals.
  
  
Fresenius Medical Care is a people business. Our success depends on having the best and brightest employees and helping them attain their personal and professional goals while delivering excellence in patient care and business results. Our employees embody our culture which is based on core values supporting our promise to improve the quality of life of every patient every day. These core values are:
**We Care. We Connect. We Commit.**
**Role Summary**
The OHS Paralegal supports Fresenius Medical Care's ("FME") occupational health & safety (OHS) legal/compliance programme for its assigned region (currently Germany), providing coordination, drafting, reporting and administrative execution across OHS policy harmonization, KPI reporting, incident-reporting tool administration, and stakeholder coordination - including with local employee representative bodies, statutory accident insurance/regulatory bodies, and internal functions such as Insurance, Global Sustainability, Global HR, Clinical Development and Clinical Engineering. The role operates under the direction of regional OHS legal/compliance leadership and does not independently set OHS legal strategy or issue final interpretations of regulatory obligations.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
***Policy & Process Support***

* Support drafting, amendment and harmonization of OHS management processes, procedures and systems for the assigned region's entities, incorporating input from OHS leadership, Global Compliance, Global HR and other stakeholders, and aligned with applicable local occupational health and safety legislation
* Coordinate review and update cycles for regional OHS policies and procedures, escalating substantive legal or regulatory interpretation questions to OHS leadership
* Maintain documentation and version control for regional OHS policy materials

***Local Works Council & Regulatory Coordination***

* Support coordination with local employee representative bodies (e.g. works councils) on health and safety matters subject to co-determination or consultation rights under applicable local employment law, preparing briefing materials and tracking consultation and agreement processes under attorney/HR direction
* Support coordination with local statutory accident insurance/regulatory bodies and labour inspectorates, including reporting and documentation obligations
* Track local regulatory deadlines and filing/reporting obligations relevant to OHS compliance

***Reporting & KPI Administration***

* Administer regular reporting of OHS KPIs for the assigned region's entities, compiling data and preparing materials to support OHS standards and target-setting
* Support the maintenance and continuous improvement of the digital incident reporting tool, including data accuracy checks, user support and adoption tracking
* Support automation initiatives and exploration of digital solutions for OHS reporting and analytics, coordinating with IT and relevant vendors

***Data, Risk & Remediation Support***

* Support regular data, risk and impact analysis for regional OHS matters, compiling findings for review by OHS leadership
* Track and coordinate remediation action items arising from OHS risk/incident analysis, following up with responsible stakeholders on completion

***Knowledge Management & Training Support***

* Support development of OHS training materials and training concepts under the direction of OHS leadership
* Maintain OHS knowledge management resources and documentation for internal reference

**Level-Specific Scope**

* Manages significant regional OHS process/reporting workstreams with limited oversight from OHS leadership; coaches and delegates work to more junior paralegals/support staff
* Makes decisions on complex, sometimes ambiguous coordination and process matters; escalates matters requiring legal interpretation of local OHS regulatory obligations or works council co-determination questions to OHS leadership
* Advises OHS leadership on process and operational improvements of significance (e.g. KPI reporting design, incident tool functionality, works council briefing materials) but does not independently set OHS legal strategy or negotiate directly with employee representative bodies
* Represents the OHS function in cross-functional coordination relevant to the assigned region's entities
* Improves existing OHS management processes and reporting methods; does not have authority to create new standards independently
* Does not provide legal advice or make final determinations on regulatory compliance obligations - supports and prepares under attorney/OHS-leadership direction

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree with approximately 8 -12 years of relevant experience (or Master's degree with 6+ years, or PhD with 3+ years), including substantial experience in EHS/OHS compliance administration, legal operations, or a comparable regulatory-support function, ideally with exposure to the employment/OHS law of the supported region
* Working knowledge of the OHS regulatory framework and employee representative/works council consultation processes applicable to the supported region preferred
* Experience with digital incident reporting/EHS management systems and data analytics tools
* Strong drafting, coordination and project-management skills; experience supporting policy harmonization projects
* Excellent written and spoken English required
* High attention to detail, discretion and ability to manage confidential/sensitive information

**Our offer:**

* Growth Opportunity: Be part of the dynamic growth and transformation of Fresenius Medical Care India Global Hub.
* Career Development: Access to challenging and rewarding opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
* Hybrid Work Environment: Benefit from a flexible hybrid work setup that supports productivity and work-life balance.
* Transportation Facilities: Convenient company-provided cab services for pick-up and drop-off.
* Comprehensive Medical Benefits: Attractive medical benefits coverage for employees and their families.
* Cafeteria Benefits: Complimentary lunch facility at the workplace.
* Global Exposure: Gain valuable global exposure and access to diverse learning and development opportunities.

title: Senior Manager - Data Privacy & Protection
description:
**The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance:**
At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.
  
  
As India’s first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.
  
  
We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what’s next.
  
  
If you’re driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you’ll feel right at home here.
  
  
**About the Role:**
We are looking for a high-agency Data Protection & Privacy leader to drive end-to-end privacy, governance, and data protection initiatives across CoinDCX.
  
  
This role will be responsible for identifying critical privacy and data governance gaps across business functions, building scalable compliance and risk mitigation frameworks, and ensuring execution that strengthens data security, regulatory adherence, user trust, and organizational resilience.
  
  
**What You’ll Do:**

* Design, plan, and execute activities to ensure compliance with UAE PDPL, DPDPA, ISO 27701, and other relevant data protection and privacy regulations and standards.
* Develop and implement processes to maintain ongoing compliance and readiness for external assessments and certifications.
* Drive data protection and privacy awareness activities through various channels such as mailers, digital posters, fliers, games, events, campaigns, and communications.
* Identify training requirements, develop and launch training programs, and ensure high completion rates across the organization.
* Conduct targeted data protection and privacy training sessions for different roles within the organization.
* Identify and manage data protection and privacy risks through risk assessments, collaboration with risk owners, and continuous risk reporting to management.
* Evaluate and monitor the effectiveness of data protection and privacy controls through internal audits and assessments, ensuring timely remediation of any identified gaps.
* Design, develop, and publish data protection and privacy policies, procedures, and guidelines, managing their lifecycle activities.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including legal, compliance, engineering, operations, and security, to ensure data privacy compliance.
* Track and ensure timely publication of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) by respective internal stakeholders.
* Facilitate external audits in collaboration with internal stakeholders and auditors, ensuring timely closure of audit findings.
* Identify and escalate risks in third-party engagements by conducting third-party risk assessments for new requests and annual reviews, suggesting process improvements as needed.
* Manage data breach response planning and execution, if necessary.
* Develop dashboards and publish periodic reporting on data protection and privacy risks, internal control compliance, and audit/assessment findings to management.
* Continuously improve the data protection and privacy control framework and look for automation opportunities to reduce manual efforts in processes.
* Provide guidance and support to other team members and less experienced colleagues.
* Plan, design, and execute data protection and privacy assessment activities for mergers and acquisitions, providing regular status updates to stakeholders.
* Perform regulatory and statutory audit compliance activities with timely completion.

**You’ll Know You’re Winning When:**

* 7-9 years of overall experience in the data protection and privacy domain with 6 years of relevant experience in managing data protection and privacy programs.
* Strong knowledge and implementation experience of data protection and privacy management frameworks, regulatory requirements, and applicable standards such as DPDPA, GDPR, ISO 27701, ISO 27001, etc.
* Demonstrated experience in conducting risk assessments, data protection and privacy assessments, internal audits, and facilitating/driving external audits.
* Solid experience in driving successful data protection and privacy awareness programs, activities, and training across the organization.
* Strong knowledge and experience in data protection and privacy governance, risk management, and compliance frameworks.
* Ability to communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong team player and collaborative problem solver, committed to achieving shared team goals and fostering a positive work environment.
* Strong verbal, written communication, and interpersonal skills.
* Proficient in managing tasks under time constraints, ad-hoc work assignments, adept at independently reassessing priorities with attention to detail.
* Ability to deal with ambiguity and work towards a plan of action.
* Professional certifications such as ISO 27001 / ISO 27701 LA/LI, CIPM, CIPP/E, or other relevant certifications are a plus.
* Good knowledge or understanding of Cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP is an advantage.

﻿﻿﻿
  
  
**Hiring Process:**
Here’s what your journey with us looks like:
  
  

* Application Review – We assess for skills, alignment, and intent
* Recruiter Connect – A short conversation to understand you better
* Functional Round(s) – Deep dive into your approach, craft, and problem-solving
* Assignment / Simulation Round – A take-home task or live problem-solving exercise to understand how you think and execute in real scenarios
* Culture & Values Discussion – A conversation to understand our ways of working and how you thrive best
* Founder Conversation (Optional) – For certain roles and senior levels, you may meet our founders to explore strategic alignment and long-term fit

**Where We Work:**
We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.
  
  
With this belief, we operate as a work-from-office organisation. This role is based out of our
**Bengaluru**
office, where energy, alignment and innovation move in real time.
  
  
**Perks That Empower You:**
We believe great people deserve great experiences.
  
  

* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle
* Unlimited Wellness Leaves: Rest and recharge as you need
* Mental Wellness Support: Access to therapy and wellness resources
* Learning Sessions: Bi-weekly learning and growth opportunities

**Ready to Build What’s Next?**
If you’re looking for a role that gives you direct access to high-stakes decisions, deep impact and a chance to build the future of finance, this is it.
  
  
Join CoinDCX and help us make crypto accessible to every Indian, together.
