title: Managed Services Governance Advisor
description:
Job Purpose and Impact
  
  
The Advisor , Managed Services will act as the primary governance lead for Managed Services engagements, ensuring contractual commitments, service performance, commercial obligations, and change activities are effectively governed. Drive continuous improvement, transparency, risk mitigation, and value realization across managed service partnerships.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  
**Managed Services Governance & Performance Management**

* Own overall performance and partnership management through an integrated governance model across contract, financial, and change management.
* Partner with CSSP, FP&A, DT&D, and supplier teams to operate governance cadences at operational and executive levels.
* Oversee supplier performance against SLAs, KPIs, XLAs, contractual commitments, milestones, and transformation roadmaps; drive corrective actions and SIPs through the governance forums

**Commercial Governance, Financial Management & Pricing**

* Govern commercial commitments, contractual obligations, pricing constructs, budget utilization, forecasts, savings, and value realization.
* Validate invoices against contracts, pricing schedules, approved changes, service volumes, consumption data, and resource rates.
* Monitor commercial risks, COLA increases, financial exposures, penalties/credits, pricing inefficiencies, and optimization opportunities.
* Support benchmarking, renewals, pricing negotiations, and commercial impact assessments.

**Change Management Governance & Invoice QA**

* Govern managed services changes through established CAB and approval processes, including review of scope, cost, risk, impact, and contractual alignment.
* Ensure documentation and approvals for changes, track implementation success and cumulative impacts on service performance and costs.
* Perform invoice QA before payment, identify billing discrepancies, track recurring issues, and drive root cause resolution.

**Risk, Issue, Tool Enablement & Data Insights**

* Maintain centralized issue and risk registers; track remediation actions, mitigation plans, supplier dependencies, and delivery risks.
* Escalate critical operational, commercial, security, and compliance concerns; provide concise leadership risk summaries.
* Drive adoption of governance tools and platforms such as ServiceNow, Power BI, Power Automate, SAP/Ariba, Beeline, Jira, SharePoint, and CLM platforms.
* Improve governance dashboards, scorecards, automated reporting, data quality, workflow automation, and governance repositories.

**Continuous Improvement & Value Realization**

* Identify opportunities to improve service quality, governance maturity, automation, process optimization, and commercial outcomes.
* Track contracted benefits, savings, efficiencies, and value realization; conduct lessons learned reviews and maturity assessments.
* Promote best practices consistently across managed services suppliers.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Finance, Supply Chain, or related field.
* 8+ years of experience in Supplier Governance, Vendor Management, Managed Services Governance, IT Service Management, Commercial Management, or Outsourcing Governance.
* Demonstrated experience managing supplier performance, governance forums, SLAs/KPIs, contract compliance, commercial obligations, and risk management activities.
* Experience with managed services engagements across Application, Infrastructure, End User, Cloud, or Digital Workplace services.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen with experience in invoice validation, pricing analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and value realization.
* Proficiency with governance and reporting tools such as ServiceNow, Power BI, SAP/Ariba, Jira, SharePoint, and workflow automation platforms.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and executive presentation skills.
* ITIL, SIAM, PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or Vendor Management certifications preferred.
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification preferred.

title: Manager - Compliance
description:
**About CoinSwitch**
CoinSwitch is one of India's leading crypto investment platforms and is registered with FIU-IND as a Virtual Digital Asset Service Provider (VDA SP).
  
  
Our Compliance team works across AML/CFT controls, transaction monitoring, blockchain investigations, customer due diligence, regulatory reporting and engagement with FIU-IND and law enforcement agencies. We work closely with internal teams to strengthen controls, address emerging risks and meet our regulatory obligations.
  
  
We are looking for a Compliance Manager who brings strong AML/CFT experience, sound judgement and a hands-on approach to managing compliance operations in a fast-evolving virtual digital asset ecosystem.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
Transaction Monitoring and AML Investigations
  
  

* Lead the review and investigation of transaction monitoring alerts across fiat and virtual digital asset transactions, including complex and high-risk cases.
* Assess suspicious activity, determine appropriate escalation and reporting, and prepare high-quality Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) with clear, evidence-based narratives.
* Review transaction monitoring scenarios, thresholds and red flags to improve detection effectiveness and reduce false positives.
* Identify emerging typologies, unusual transaction patterns and potential misuse of the platform, and translate findings into actionable control improvements.

Blockchain Analytics and Travel Rule Compliance
  
  

* Conduct blockchain investigations using analytics tools to trace fund flows, assess wallet exposure and investigate links to illicit activity, including scams, darknet services, mixers and sanctioned entities.
* Review virtual asset deposits and relevant wallet exposure alerts, document findings and take appropriate action in line with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
* Support Travel Rule compliance, including information exchange with counterparty VASPs, and review cases involving unhosted wallets in accordance with applicable requirements.

Regulatory Compliance and FIU-IND Reporting
  
  

* Ensure timely and accurate filing of STRs and other applicable regulatory reports in accordance with PMLA, the PML Rules and FIU-IND requirements.
* Oversee compliance with customer due diligence, beneficial ownership identification, risk categorisation, periodic KYC updates and enhanced due diligence requirements.
* Ensure appropriate maintenance and retrieval of KYC, transaction and investigation records in accordance with applicable record-retention requirements.
* Monitor regulatory circulars, advisories, notifications and emerging AML/CFT typologies, and assess their impact on existing policies, controls and procedures.
* Support the Designated Director and Principal Officer in meeting applicable regulatory obligations, including independent AML/CFT audits and remediation of audit observations.

KYC, Screening and Enhanced Due Diligence
  
  

* Oversee customer screening against applicable sanctions lists, PEP databases, adverse media and other relevant watchlists.
* Review screening matches, ensure appropriate disposition of potential matches and support timely action on applicable sanctions and freezing requirements.
* Review high-risk customers and transactions, including complex fund flows, high-value activity and cases requiring enhanced due diligence.
* Strengthen customer risk assessment and ongoing monitoring processes based on customer profiles, transaction behaviour and emerging risk indicators.

Law Enforcement and Regulatory Engagement
  
  

* Manage responses to requests from law enforcement agencies, FIU-IND and other competent authorities, including information requests, notices and account-related directions.
* Coordinate the collection, validation and submission of relevant customer, transaction and investigation records within prescribed timelines.
* Support regulatory inspections, compliance reviews, audits and information requests, ensuring that responses are accurate, complete and appropriately documented.
* Track regulatory observations and agreed action plans through to closure, working with relevant stakeholders where required.

Compliance Governance, Reporting and Team Management
  
  

* Prepare management updates and periodic compliance reports covering key risks, suspicious activity trends, control effectiveness and regulatory developments.
* Contribute to enterprise-wide AML/CFT risk assessments and periodic reviews of policies, procedures and internal controls.
* Work with Product, Engineering, Data and Operations teams to strengthen monitoring capabilities, improve investigative workflows and address identified control gaps.
* Maintain clear investigation records, case documentation and audit trails to support regulatory scrutiny and internal reviews.
* Guide analysts on case investigations, STR quality, screening decisions and escalation standards, while supporting ongoing training and capability development.

What we're looking for
  
  

* Mandatory: CAMS certification from ACAMS.
* 5–8 years of overall professional experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on AML/CFT experience in a VDA platform, bank, NBFC, payments company, brokerage or a comparable regulated financial services environment.
* Strong working knowledge of PMLA, 2002, the Prevention of Money-laundering (Maintenance of Records) Rules, 2005, and FIU-IND's AML/CFT requirements for VDA SPs.
* A sound understanding of FATF Recommendations, particularly Recommendations 15 and 16, and their relevance to virtual asset activities.
* Practical experience in transaction monitoring, suspicious transaction investigations and STR preparation and filing.
* Experience handling law enforcement requests, regulatory information requests and time-sensitive compliance matters.
* The ability to analyse transaction data, identify patterns and draw meaningful conclusions using Excel and, preferably, SQL or similar data analysis tools.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear investigation reports, regulatory responses and management updates.
* Good judgement, attention to detail and the ability to independently manage complex cases while guiding junior team members.

Good to have
  
  

* Hands-on experience with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis Reactor/KYT, TRM Labs or Elliptic.
* Experience working with transaction monitoring, screening or case management systems, including rule configuration, threshold optimisation and control testing.
* Exposure to Travel Rule implementation and interactions with counterparty VASPs.
* Experience with virtual asset regulatory frameworks outside India, including VARA (Dubai) or CBB (Bahrain).
* Additional certifications such as CCAS, CFE or ICA qualifications.

**Location:**
Bengaluru (Hybrid)
  
  
**Experience:**
5–8 years, including at least 3 years of hands-on AML/CFT experience
  
  
**Certification:**
CAMS (ACAMS) – Mandatory

title: Senior Governance, Risk and Compliance Specialist
description:
CUBE are a global RegTech business defining and implementing the gold standard of regulatory intelligence for the financial services industry. We deliver our services through intuitive SaaS solutions, powered by AI, to simplify the complex and everchanging world of compliance for our clients.
  
  
**Why us?**
🌍 CUBE is a globally recognized brand at the forefront of Regulatory Technology. Our industry-leading SaaS solutions are trusted by the world’s top financial institutions globally.
  
  
🚀 In 2024, we achieved over 50% growth, both organically and through two strategic acquisitions. We’re a fast-paced, high-performing team that thrives on pushing boundaries—continuously evolving our products, services, and operations. At CUBE, we don’t just keep up we stay ahead.
  
  
🌱 We believe our future is built by bold, ambitious individuals who are driven to make a real difference. Our “make it happen” culture empowers you to take ownership of your career and accelerate your personal and professional development from day one.
  
  
🌐 With over 700 CUBERs across 19 countries spanning EMEA, the Americas, and APAC, we operate as one team with a shared mission to transform regulatory compliance. Diversity, collaboration, and purpose are the heartbeat of our success.
  
  
💡 We were among the first to harness the power of AI in regulatory intelligence, and we continue to lead with our cutting-edge technology. At CUBE, You will work alongside some of the brightest minds in AI research and engineering in developing impactful solutions that are reshaping the world of regulatory compliance.
  
  
Purpose
  
  
Provide senior analyst support across technology governance, risk, and compliance by keeping GRC data, workflows, actions, and reporting current and reliable. This role helps the organisation maintain audit readiness, strengthen accountability for risk actions, and provide clear visibility of compliance status, control health, and remediation progress.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Maintain GRC portals, including risk registers, control records, evidence libraries, issue logs, policy links, assessment workflows, dashboards, and reporting views.
* Ensure GRC portal dat a is complete, accurate, consistently classified, and aligned to agreed standards for risk, control, issue, and evidence management.
* Coordinate portal updates, access reviews, workflow changes, template improvements, and reporting enhancements with technology, security, and business stakeholders.
* Perform regular data quality checks across GRC records and follow up with owners to correct missing, outdated, or inconsistent information.
* Own and manage the risk action calendar, covering risk assessments, control reviews, evidence refresh cycles, policy reviews, audit milestones, remediation deadlines, governance forums, and leadership reporting.
* Track action owners, due dates, dependencies, and completion status for risk and compliance activity.
* Proactively follow up on upcoming, overdue, or blocked actions, escalating material risks, delays, and dependencies through the appropriate governance channels.
* Use the calendar to support forward planning, workload visibility, and timely completion of recurring GRC obligations.
* Support technology risk assessments, control reviews, compliance checks, and issue management activity across security, technology, and business teams.
* Maintain and update risk registers, control mappings, compliance evidence, remediation plans, and exception records.
* Support the interpretation of policy, regulatory, contractual, and audit requirements into practical actions for control and risk owners.
* Monitor remediation progress and help ensure risk treatment plans are realistic, tracked, evidenced, and closed appropriately.
* Prepare risk and compliance status reports, dashboards, metrics, and packs for governance forums and leadership review.
* Coordinate evidence collection for internal audits, external audits, customer assurance requests, and compliance reviews.
* Validate that evidence is current, complete, clearly labelled, and mapped to the relevant controls or obligations.
* Support audit walkthroughs, control owner preparation, finding tracking, and post-audit remediation follow-up.
* Maintain reusable evidence and control documentation to reduce repeated requests and improve audit readiness.
* Partner with security, technology, legal, procurement, internal audit, and business teams to drive clear ownership of GRC actions.
* Provide guidance to control and risk owners on GRC processes, portal usage, evidence expectations, and action tracking.
* Identify opportunities to improve GRC workflows, portal usability, reporting, data quality, and stakeholder accountability.
* Contribute to the maintenance of GRC procedures, guidance materials, and operating rhythms.
* Provide support with the compliance inbox.

Skills & Competencies
  
  

* Strong experience in governance, risk, and compliance operations within a technology, cybersecurity, audit, or regulated environment.
* Practical experience maintaining GRC tools or portals, including risks, controls, issues, evidence, workflows, dashboards, and reporting.
* Strong planning and coordination skills, with the ability to manage calendars, action trackers, recurring obligations, and cross-functional follow-ups.
* Good working knowledge of technology risk management, control frameworks, audit evidence, compliance reporting, and remediation tracking.
* Ability to interpret risk and compliance requirements and translate them into clear actions for stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accurate, well-governed records.
* Confident communication skills, including the ability to follow up, challenge constructively, and escalate when required.
* Comfortable working with senior stakeholders, control owners, auditors, and technical teams.
* Strong written documentation skills and the ability to produce clear status reports, dashboards, and governance packs.
* Familiarity with frameworks and obligations such as ISO 27001, NIST, SOC 2, SOX, PCI DSS, GDPR, COBIT, or DORA.
* Experience with GRC platforms such as Vanta, ServiceNow GRC, Archer, OneTrust, LogicGate, AuditBoard, Jira-based risk workflows, or equivalent tooling.
* Experience supporting third-party risk, policy management, control testing, or regulatory compliance programmes.
* Relevant certification such as CISA, CRISC, CISM, CISSP, ISO 27001, or equivalent professional experience.

**Interested?**
If you are passionate about leveraging technology to transform regulatory compliance and meet the qualifications outlined above, we invite you to apply. Please submit your resume detailing your relevant experience and interest in CUBE.
  
  
CUBE is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: Product Compliance Manager
description:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.
  
  
Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.
  
  
It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.
  
  
Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.
  
  
In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are building Nium's Product Compliance function as a strategic capability that enables safe, scalable global growth.
  
  
As a Product Compliance Manager, you will sit at the intersection of Product, Payments, Risk, Compliance, Legal, Engineering and AI. You will help ensure that Nium's products are designed, launched and operated in line with regulatory expectations across multiple jurisdictions.
  
  
This role goes beyond interpreting regulation. You will understand how products and payment flows work end-to-end, identify regulatory and financial crime risks, and work with Product and Engineering teams to design practical controls directly into the product and operating model.
  
  
We are looking for a builder and systems thinker who can turn complex regulatory requirements into scalable solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Product Advisory & Risk**

* Partner with Product, Business and Engineering teams from ideation through launch and ongoing product evolution
* Understand customer journeys, product architecture and end-to-end payment flows
* Assess new products, features, payment methods, partnerships and material product changes
* Independently lead New Product Risk Assessments (NPRAs) and identify regulatory, financial crime and operational risks
* Translate regulatory obligations into clear product requirements and proportionate controls
* Challenge product designs where risks are not adequately addressed and help teams develop workable alternatives

**Product Assurance**

* Review existing products and processes for compliance gaps and emerging risks
* Assess the impact of new markets, products, payment flows and material changes
* Drive remediation of identified gaps and track controls through implementation
* Identify systemic risks and reusable solutions across products rather than solving issues individually
* Contribute to periodic Product Compliance health reviews and ongoing oversight

**Regulatory Intelligence**

* Monitor regulatory developments relevant to Nium's products and markets
* Assess how regulatory changes impact product design, processes and controls
* Develop reusable jurisdictional guidance, playbooks and compliance knowledge
* Partner with regional Compliance and MLRO teams to translate local requirements into scalable product solutions

**AI & Automation**

* Identify opportunities to use technology and AI to make Product Compliance more scalable and effective
* Help develop AI-assisted compliance workflows and knowledge-management capabilities
* Identify repetitive compliance activities that can be automated
* Contribute to initiatives such as Compliance Copilot and other Product Compliance tooling

**Requirements**

* 5–7 years of experience in Product Compliance, Payments Risk, Financial Crime, Product Risk, Product Management, or a similar role within fintech, payments or financial services
* Strong understanding of digital products, payment flows and customer journeys
* Experience translating regulatory or risk requirements into practical product, process or control solutions
* Experience working cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Business, Risk and/or Compliance teams
* Ability to independently manage ambiguous problems and drive them from assessment through recommendation and implementation
* Strong written and verbal communication, structured problem-solving and stakeholder management skills
* Comfortable influencing teams without relying on formal authority

**Strongly Preferred**

* Cross-border payments and remittances
* Stablecoins, digital assets or crypto
* Cards and card issuing
* Fraud and financial crime
* KYC/KYB and customer lifecycle controls
* Multi-jurisdictional regulatory environments

**Nice to have:**
SQL, APIs, workflow/automation tools and experience using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini.
  
  
**What Success Looks Like**

* Become a trusted Product Compliance partner to Product and Business teams
* Independently assess complex products, customer journeys and payment flows
* Lead Product Risk Assessments and translate regulatory requirements into pragmatic, scalable controls
* Identify and drive resolution of product compliance gaps
* Identify systemic risks and opportunities to improve controls across products
* Build reusable Product Compliance frameworks, playbooks and knowledge assets
* Help make Product Compliance more technology-enabled and scalable

**What This Role Is Not**
This is not a traditional compliance operations or investigations role.
  
  
Experience in AML, KYC/KYB, sanctions or financial crime is valuable, but we are not primarily looking for someone whose experience has been limited to:
  
  

* AML investigations or transaction monitoring
* KYC/KYB operations or document verification
* Sanctions screening operations
* Case management
* Regulatory reporting execution
* Manual compliance reviews with limited product or technology engagement

We are looking for someone who enjoys asking:
  
  

* How does this product work end-to-end?
* Where does regulatory or financial crime risk enter the flow?
* What is the simplest effective control?
* How can we make compliance the default rather than an afterthought?
* How can technology and AI make the control more scalable?

If you enjoy solving ambiguous problems, understanding how financial products work and building practical solutions at the intersection of product, technology and regulation, this role is for you.
  
  
**What We Offer At Nium**
**We Value Performance:**
Through competitive salaries, performance bonuses, sales commissions, equity for specific roles and recognition programs, we ensure that all our employees are well rewarded and incentivized for their hard work.
  
  
**We Care for Our Employees:**
The wellness of Nium’ers is our #1 priority. We offer medical coverage along with 24/7 employee assistance program, generous vacation programs including our year-end shut down. We also provide a flexible working hybrid working environment (3 days per week in the office).
  
  
**We Upskill Ourselves:**
We are curious, and always want to learn more with a focus on upskilling ourselves. We provide role-specific training, internal workshops, and a learning stipend.
  
  
**We Celebrate Together:**
We recognize that work is also about creating great relationships with each other. We celebrate together with company-wide social events, team bonding activities, happy hours, team offsites, and much more!
  
  
**We Thrive with Diversity:**
Nium is truly a global company, with more than 33 nationalities, based in 18+ countries and more than 10 office locations. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to providing a safe and welcoming environment for everyone.
  
  
**Beware of recruitment scams:**
Be cautious of individuals impersonating Nium via WhatsApp, social media, email or unofficial websites.
**Do not respond, share personal or financial information, or make any payments**
. Nium will never ask candidates to transfer money or cryptocurrency as part of our recruitment process.
  
  
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Manager / Assistant Manager / Senior Executive – GST Advisory, Litigation & Compliance
description:
Job Description – GST Advisory, Litigation & Compliance

Position: Manager/Assistant Manager / Senior Executive

Experience: 2–5 Years

Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) / CA Inter / Commerce Graduate or Postgraduate with relevant GST experience

Location: Bangalore

Employment Type: Full-Time

Organisation: KASP & Associates – Chartered Accountants

**About the Role**

We are looking for a technically competent and proactive professional to handle GST advisory, litigation, departmental assessments and compliance reviews for a diverse portfolio of clients. The role involves providing practical GST solutions, representing clients in departmental proceedings, identifying tax risks and implementing robust GST compliance policies and best practices.

The candidate should possess strong analytical skills, sound knowledge of GST laws and the ability to independently manage client assignments and coordinate with GST authorities.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. GST Advisory & Technical Research

• Provide advisory on complex GST matters, including taxability, classification, rate applicability, input tax credit (ITC), place of supply, time of supply and reverse charge mechanism.

• Analyse GST implications of business transactions, contracts, restructuring and commercial arrangements.

• Research GST provisions, notifications, circulars, advance rulings and judicial precedents.

• Prepare technical notes, opinions and advisory reports for clients.

• Identify GST exposure areas and recommend appropriate mitigation measures.

2. GST Litigation & Departmental Proceedings

• Handle GST notices, show-cause notices (SCNs), audit observations, demand orders and other departmental communications.

• Draft replies to notices, submissions, representations and appeals before GST authorities.

• Assist in first appeals, appellate proceedings, rectification applications and other appropriate remedies.

• Represent clients before GST officers and coordinate with departmental authorities during proceedings.

• Analyse adjudication orders, identify legal and factual issues, and recommend suitable courses of action.

• Track litigation status, statutory deadlines, pre-deposit requirements and appeal timelines.

3. GST Assessments, Audits & Investigations

• Handle departmental GST assessments, scrutiny proceedings and audit-related matters.

• Review reconciliation of GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-2B, books of accounts and annual returns.

• Analyse ITC mismatches, tax differences, e-invoicing issues, e-way bill discrepancies and other compliance gaps.

• Assist clients during departmental audits, inspections, investigations and summons proceedings.

• Evaluate potential tax demands, interest and penalties and advise on appropriate responses.

4. GST Compliance Review & Best Practices

• Review existing GST compliance processes and identify control gaps and areas of improvement.

• Develop and implement GST compliance policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs) and internal control checklists.

• Establish review mechanisms for ITC eligibility, vendor compliance, reconciliations, return filing and tax payments.

• Recommend preventive controls to minimise errors, interest, penalties and litigation exposure.

• Conduct periodic GST health checks and compliance risk assessments.

• Support process improvements, documentation standards and timely statutory compliance.

5. Client Management & Team Coordination

• Independently manage assigned client engagements and ensure timely completion of deliverables.

• Interact with clients to understand business transactions, obtain information and explain GST implications.

• Coordinate with internal teams handling GST return filing, accounting and other statutory compliances.

• Maintain proper documentation, case files, litigation trackers and compliance calendars.

• Keep clients and reporting partners updated on assignment progress, key risks and pending matters.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

• Strong working knowledge of the CGST Act, SGST Acts, IGST Act and applicable GST Rules.

• Practical experience in GST advisory, notice handling, assessments and litigation support.

• Good drafting, legal research, analytical and reconciliation skills.

• Ability to interpret statutory provisions, notifications, circulars and judicial decisions.

• Familiarity with GST portals, departmental procedures and relevant online legal research platforms.

• Strong client communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Ability to independently handle assignments, prioritise deadlines and maintain high-quality documentation.

• Proficiency in MS Excel and preparation of professional reports and submissions.

Preferred Candidate Profile

• CA / CA Inter / relevant commerce professional with 2–5 years of practical GST experience.

• Experience in a Chartered Accountancy firm, tax consultancy or professional services environment.

• Candidates with hands-on exposure to GST litigation, departmental assessments and advisory assignments will be preferred.

• A proactive professional who can identify issues, develop practical solutions and improve client compliance processes.

**What We Offer**

• Exposure to diverse industries and complex GST matters.

• Opportunities to work on advisory, litigation, assessments and compliance improvement assignments.

• Direct interaction with clients and senior professionals.

Interested candidates can share their resume and current CTC at contact@kaspglobal.com.

title: Data Privacy Intern
description:
About Comply Ark
  

Comply Ark is a regulatory infrastructure company building software for data protection compliance under the DPDPA and global privacy regimes.

We build two products. DataLens is a full-stack, data-blind compliance platform for the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the DPDP Rules, 2025. It discovers and classifies personal data across an organisation's systems, generates the records of processing, runs consent and data principal requests, and supports breach response, all without personal data ever leaving the customer's environment.

Comply Ark was founded by Navaneeth SS, a technology and data protection lawyer who previously practised at a leading Indian technology law firm, and Midhun MP, a full-stack engineer who owns the technical architecture of DataLens. A technology and data protection lawyer and a full-stack engineer: the exact pairing this category has been missing. The company is DPIIT-recognised, a recipient of the Kerala Startup Mission Idea Grant, and part of the current ISB iVi (I-Venture Immersive) cohort.

The role

This is one role that spans law, technology and business, because privacy compliance is now all three at once. The DPDPA is in force, and its obligations become enforceable in May 2027. Most organisations need 6 to 12 months to become compliant, and penalties reach up to ₹250 crore per breach. That makes the buying window now. Organisations need someone who can read the Act closely, understand how their systems actually hold personal data, and explain both to a General Counsel and a CISO in the same meeting.

As a Data Privacy Intern, you will do that work inside a company building the infrastructure for it. You will research the law, test and shape the products against it, and take both to the market. This is not a legal internship with some technology on the side, or a sales internship with some reading attached. Every intern works across all three areas below. The weighting shifts with your background and strengths, and a typical split is about 40 percent privacy and regulatory work, 30 percent product, and 30 percent business development.

What you will do

You will produce work that ships: research the product team builds on, test findings that change the product, and account work that moves real conversations forward.

Privacy and regulatory

* Read the DPDPA and the DPDP Rules, 2025 at sub-section level, and translate obligations into operational requirements for specific sectors such as banking and fintech, insurance, healthcare, edtech and e-commerce.
* Track regulatory developments in India, including notifications, Data Protection Board activity and sectoral regulator guidance, and in the global regimes CookieGate covers, including GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, LGPD and PDPL.
* Draft and cite-check knowledge content such as client briefings, updates to the Comply Ark DPDPA whitepaper, product FAQs and the DataLens content series, with every claim traced to the official text.

Product and technology

* Map legal obligations to DataLens and CookieGate features, and write them up as clear requirements with acceptance criteria the engineering team can build and test against.
* Test the products the way a compliance officer would use them: run data principal request flows, review generated records of processing, check consent records, and log every issue with reproducible steps.
* Review cookie and tracker classifications across jurisdictions, flag misclassifications, and help build the reference datasets that improve classification accuracy.
* Build sector-specific demo scenarios and sample data so that each demo speaks to the prospect's own regulatory exposure.

Business development

* Research and qualify target accounts in regulated, data-heavy sectors, map their buying committees, from the General Counsel and Chief Compliance Officer to the CTO, CISO and DPO, and keep the sales tracker current.
* Build and update sector playbooks covering regulatory exposure, typical data flows, buying triggers and likely objections.
* Support outbound and demos with account research notes, tailored follow-ups, meeting notes and post-meeting debriefs.
* Support partnerships with law firms and compliance consultancies, from partner research to the material they need to work with us.

You will not give legal advice to customers or prospects. Comply Ark builds software, it is not a consulting firm, and any client-facing statement on the law is reviewed by the founders before it leaves the company.

Who we are looking for

We welcome applicants from law, technology and business, and we hire for judgement, precision and ownership rather than for a particular degree.

You should be a student in the later years of your degree, or a graduate within one year of completing it. Your background decides where you start, and the role expects you to grow into the other two areas.

Background

Typical degrees

What we expect you to bring

Law

B.A. LL.B., LL.B., LL.M.

Close reading of statute at sub-section level, structured legal writing, and a working grasp of how privacy regimes compare

Technology

B.Tech, B.E., BCA, MCA, B.Sc. in computing

A clear model of how systems store and move personal data, from databases and APIs to cookies and third-party scripts, plus basic SQL or Python

Business

BBA, B.Com, MBA, PGDM

Account research, clear commercial writing, comfort with a CRM or tracker, and the confidence to speak with senior buyers

What every applicant needs

* Precise written English. Most of your work will be read by lawyers, engineers or buyers, and each of them will notice loose wording.
* A real interest in data protection, shown through coursework, writing, projects, moots, internships or self-study.
* Comfort with technology. You do not need to code, but you must be willing to understand how a product works and to test it carefully.
* Good use of AI tools, paired with the discipline to verify every output against the source.
* The habits remote work demands: you communicate without being chased, meet the deadlines you set, and say early when something is off track.

What will set you apart

* A privacy certification such as CIPP/E, CIPP/A, CIPM or CIPT, or one in progress.
* Published writing, a moot, research or a project on data protection or technology law.
* Prior internship experience at a law firm, a compliance team, a privacy or security company, or an early-stage startup.
* Hands-on familiarity with browser developer tools, cloud consoles or consent management platforms.
* Prior work on outreach, partnerships or sales, in any setting.

How we work

The internship is fully remote, and it runs on written work, clear weekly commitments and regular feedback.

* You agree your weekly working hours with us at the start, with regular overlap during Indian working hours for reviews and collaboration. If you are studying, we plan around your examinations in advance rather than at the last minute.
* Every intern has a weekly review with a founder and sends a short written update at the end of each week covering what was done, what is next and what is blocked.
* Work happens in writing, in shared documents and trackers, so that anyone can pick it up without a meeting.
* You need your own laptop and a reliable internet connection. We provide Comply Ark accounts and the tools the work requires.
* Before you start, you sign a confidentiality and intellectual property agreement.

What you will get

You will learn data protection the way it is actually practised now, at the point where the law, the system and the buyer meet.

* Direct work with both founders, a technology and data protection lawyer and a full-stack engineer, with weekly feedback on your work.
* Real ownership. Your research, test findings and account work feed into the products and conversations that Comply Ark is running.
* Exposure to how enterprise buyers in regulated sectors evaluate privacy software, from the first conversation to the demo.
* Credit for your work. Where something you wrote is published, you will be named.
* A monthly stipend, a certificate of completion, and a letter of recommendation for interns whose work earns one.
* The possibility of a pre-placement offer, based on your performance during the internship.

How to apply

Apply through this LinkedIn job post with an up-to-date CV. We accept applications only through LinkedIn, so that every candidate goes through the same process.

We review applications on a rolling basis, and the process runs in five steps:

1. **Application review.**
   We read every CV against what this posting asks for.
2. **Candidate questionnaire.**
   Shortlisted candidates receive a short questionnaire that takes about 20 minutes. It includes a note of no more than 200 words on why this role, and on one data protection question you find genuinely interesting. The note carries as much weight as your CV.
3. **Work sample.**
   You choose one short task: map a DPDPA obligation to a product requirement, profile a company's regulatory exposure, or review a live website's cookie consent against the law.
4. **Interview with the founders.**
   A 30 to 45 minute conversation about your work sample and how you think.
5. **Offer.**
   We confirm the duration, weekly hours, start date and stipend in writing.

Using AI in your work is welcome, but we assess your own judgement, so please write your answers yourself. A specific answer from your own work will serve you better than a polished general one.

How we handle your personal data

We use your application data only to assess you for this role, and we hold it to the same standard we build our products for.

We erase your application 6 months after the process closes. If you would like us to keep it on file for future roles, we will ask for your consent separately, and you can withdraw that consent at any time.

You can ask us at any time for a summary of the data we hold about you, or to correct, update or erase it, by writing to careers@complyark.com. The same address handles any grievance about how we have dealt with your data. Our full privacy policy is at complyark.com/privacy-policy.

title: Legal Collections Manager
description:
**About Legodesk**

Legodesk is legal-powered recovery infrastructure for Indian lenders: banks, NBFCs, fintechs and ARCs.

We run our clients' end-to-end legal recovery workflow. That covers legal notices, execution proceedings, suit filing, arbitration, Section 138 cases, insolvency and consumer matters. The work is delivered through our technology platform and a network of partner advocates across India.

We are profitable, ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certified, CERT-In empanelled, and incubated at IIM Bangalore's NSRCEL.

**Legal Background - Not Required**

If you have managed external partners who don't report to you, we want to hear from you. Examples include field agents, collection agencies, delivery or logistics partners, distributors, franchisees, freelancers or empanelled vendors. We will teach you the legal process.

**The role:**
You own recovery outcomes for our lender clients' legal portfolios. You are the bridge between what the client expects and what the advocates deliver. You make sure cases move from notice to filing to recovery, and that both the client and Legodesk get paid.

**Responsibilities**

* Own legal recovery performance for a portfolio of NBFC and fintech clients: case progress, recovery rates and turnaround times.
* Plan the legal strategy per portfolio with the client, choosing between notice, Section 138, arbitration, suit or execution.
* Drive the advocate network on delivery: filing timelines, hearing attendance and order updates. Escalate non-performance.
* Run monthly client reviews with MIS and recovery reporting, and handle client escalations.
* Track Legodesk's billing and collection of fees from clients, and close the gap on unpaid invoices.
* Find opportunities to grow existing accounts: new case types, new geographies, higher volumes.
* Ensure compliance with the RBI Fair Practices Code and client recovery-conduct guidelines.

**Must have**

* 5–8 years in collections, legal recovery or portfolio management at a bank, NBFC, ARC, fintech or collection agency.
* A record of managing external agencies or advocates against recovery targets.
* Comfort with client-facing reviews and escalations.
* Strong with data: you can read portfolio MIS, roll rates and recovery trends.

**Good to have**

* Working knowledge of Section 138, arbitration, SARFAESI or execution proceedings.
* An LL.B. or legal background.

**You might currently be:**
a Collections Manager, Agency Manager, Legal Recovery Manager or Portfolio Manager.

title: Vendor Manager - Legal partner Network
description:
**Company:**
OSETTL Technologies Pvt. Ltd. (Legodesk)
**Location:**
HSR Layout, Bengaluru (on-site, with travel to partner cities)
**Reports to:**
Revenue Team
**Type:**
Full-time
**Experience:**
2–4 years

**About Legodesk**

Legodesk is legal-powered recovery infrastructure for Indian lenders — banks, NBFCs, fintechs and ARCs. We run the end-to-end legal recovery workflow for our clients (legal notices, execution proceedings, suit filing, arbitration, Section 138 / private complaints, insolvency and consumer matters) through a technology platform and a distributed network of partner advocates across India. We are profitable, ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certified, CERT-In empanelled, and incubated at IIM Bangalore's NSRCEL.

**The Role**

Our partner advocates are the vendors who deliver our service in court. The Vendor Manager owns that network end to end: finding and onboarding the right advocates in the right cities, allocating cases, holding them to hearing attendance and milestones, getting their payouts right, and keeping the network healthy as we expand from Karnataka into Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar and beyond.

This is not a back-office procurement role. You will directly move case throughput, recovery outcomes and revenue collection, and you will work closely with our product team to replace manual coordination with automation (WhatsApp workflows, smart case allocation, automated payouts).

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **Network Building & Onboarding**

* Identify, evaluate and empanel advocates and law firms in target states and cities, prioritised by client demand, loan volumes, default rates and court infrastructure
* Run due diligence: Bar Council enrolment, practice area and court experience, references, conflict checks
* Negotiate engagement terms and fee schedules by case type and geography; execute vendor agreements, NDAs and data-protection undertakings
* Onboard new partners onto the Legodesk platform and our SOPs within a defined timeline
* Maintain a bench of backup advocates in every active city so no case is stalled by a single dependency

**2.Case allocation & Delivery**

* Allocate incoming cases (EP, suit filing, arbitration, Section 138, insolvency, consumer) to the right advocate based on jurisdiction, capacity and track record
* Track filing timelines, hearing dates, attendance and next-date updates; escalate slippages before they become client issues
* Ensure case documents, vakalatnamas and court orders are uploaded and current on the platform
* Be the single point of escalation for partners and the internal ops team on case-level issues

**Performance & Quality Management**

* Run a partner scorecard: hearing attendance, filing TAT, update compliance, order quality, recovery outcomes and client feedback
* Conduct monthly reviews; coach, re-tier or exit under-performing partners
* Audit a sample of filings and court records each month for accuracy and compliance
* Feed partner-level insights into client reporting and account reviews

**Commercials & Payouts**

* Administer our milestone-based payout model: minimal advances, with fees released on verified milestones and hearing attendance
* Verify invoices against milestone evidence before approval; reconcile monthly with finance
* Track vendor cost per case and per state against budget; flag margin leakage early
* Resolve payment disputes quickly and fairly to keep partner trust high

**Expansion & Process**

* Execute the FY 2026-27 expansion plan across 8 states and 35 cities: hire-ahead in priority markets, ground-up network building in new ones
* Write and maintain SOPs, onboarding kits and partner communication templates
* Work with product and tech to automate allocation, reminders, updates and payouts; be the internal owner of partner-facing tools
* Manage secondary vendors where needed (process servers, courier/notice dispatch, stamp paper and notarisation, local clerks)

**Risk & Compliance**

* Ensure partners follow RBI Fair Practices Code and recovery-conduct norms, Bar Council rules and our client-specific guidelines
* Enforce data confidentiality and handling standards consistent with our ISO 27001 controls
* Maintain complete, audit-ready vendor records and agreements

**Success Metrics ( 12 Months)**

* Active, scored advocates in all priority cities, with a backup in each
* Hearing attendance and next-date update compliance at agreed SLA levels across the network
* Case allocation within 48 hours of intake
* 100% of payouts tied to verified milestones; reduced upfront advances
* Measurable reduction in manual coordination hours through automation adoption
* Partner churn and payment disputes trending down quarter on quarter

**Must Have**

* 4–7 years in vendor/partner management, legal operations, or empanelled-advocate management — ideally at a bank, NBFC, ARC, collections agency or legal-services firm
* Working knowledge of Indian recovery litigation: execution proceedings, civil suits, arbitration and award execution, Section 138 NI Act, SARFAESI, IBC
* Proven ability to negotiate fees and hold external partners accountable to SLAs
* Strong command of spreadsheets and comfort with case/workflow platforms; data-driven in how you review performance
* Excellent English and Hindi; additional regional languages (Kannada, Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Odia) are a strong plus
* Willingness to travel to partner cities

**Good to Have**

* LL.B. or legal background
* Existing advocate network in one or more of Maharashtra, Tamil Nadu, UP, Bihar, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh or Odisha
* Experience setting up a vendor network in a new geography from scratch
* Exposure to process automation or working with product teams

**Why Join**

* Own a function that directly drives revenue and recovery outcomes for India's lenders
* Build a national legal network with a technology-first operating model, not a headcount-heavy one
* Lean, profitable team with direct access to the founders
* Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives

title: Manager - Compliance
company: Lemonn | Making Trading Easy and Accessible For India
description:
**About CoinSwitch**
CoinSwitch is one of India's leading crypto investment platforms and is registered with FIU-IND as a Virtual Digital Asset Service Provider (VDA SP).
  
  
Our Compliance team works across AML/CFT controls, transaction monitoring, blockchain investigations, customer due diligence, regulatory reporting and engagement with FIU-IND and law enforcement agencies. We work closely with internal teams to strengthen controls, address emerging risks and meet our regulatory obligations.
  
  
We are looking for a Compliance Manager who brings strong AML/CFT experience, sound judgement and a hands-on approach to managing compliance operations in a fast-evolving virtual digital asset ecosystem.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
Transaction Monitoring and AML Investigations
  
  

* Lead the review and investigation of transaction monitoring alerts across fiat and virtual digital asset transactions, including complex and high-risk cases.
* Assess suspicious activity, determine appropriate escalation and reporting, and prepare high-quality Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) with clear, evidence-based narratives.
* Review transaction monitoring scenarios, thresholds and red flags to improve detection effectiveness and reduce false positives.
* Identify emerging typologies, unusual transaction patterns and potential misuse of the platform, and translate findings into actionable control improvements.

Blockchain Analytics and Travel Rule Compliance
  
  

* Conduct blockchain investigations using analytics tools to trace fund flows, assess wallet exposure and investigate links to illicit activity, including scams, darknet services, mixers and sanctioned entities.
* Review virtual asset deposits and relevant wallet exposure alerts, document findings and take appropriate action in line with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
* Support Travel Rule compliance, including information exchange with counterparty VASPs, and review cases involving unhosted wallets in accordance with applicable requirements.

Regulatory Compliance and FIU-IND Reporting
  
  

* Ensure timely and accurate filing of STRs and other applicable regulatory reports in accordance with PMLA, the PML Rules and FIU-IND requirements.
* Oversee compliance with customer due diligence, beneficial ownership identification, risk categorisation, periodic KYC updates and enhanced due diligence requirements.
* Ensure appropriate maintenance and retrieval of KYC, transaction and investigation records in accordance with applicable record-retention requirements.
* Monitor regulatory circulars, advisories, notifications and emerging AML/CFT typologies, and assess their impact on existing policies, controls and procedures.
* Support the Designated Director and Principal Officer in meeting applicable regulatory obligations, including independent AML/CFT audits and remediation of audit observations.

KYC, Screening and Enhanced Due Diligence
  
  

* Oversee customer screening against applicable sanctions lists, PEP databases, adverse media and other relevant watchlists.
* Review screening matches, ensure appropriate disposition of potential matches and support timely action on applicable sanctions and freezing requirements.
* Review high-risk customers and transactions, including complex fund flows, high-value activity and cases requiring enhanced due diligence.
* Strengthen customer risk assessment and ongoing monitoring processes based on customer profiles, transaction behaviour and emerging risk indicators.

Law Enforcement and Regulatory Engagement
  
  

* Manage responses to requests from law enforcement agencies, FIU-IND and other competent authorities, including information requests, notices and account-related directions.
* Coordinate the collection, validation and submission of relevant customer, transaction and investigation records within prescribed timelines.
* Support regulatory inspections, compliance reviews, audits and information requests, ensuring that responses are accurate, complete and appropriately documented.
* Track regulatory observations and agreed action plans through to closure, working with relevant stakeholders where required.

Compliance Governance, Reporting and Team Management
  
  

* Prepare management updates and periodic compliance reports covering key risks, suspicious activity trends, control effectiveness and regulatory developments.
* Contribute to enterprise-wide AML/CFT risk assessments and periodic reviews of policies, procedures and internal controls.
* Work with Product, Engineering, Data and Operations teams to strengthen monitoring capabilities, improve investigative workflows and address identified control gaps.
* Maintain clear investigation records, case documentation and audit trails to support regulatory scrutiny and internal reviews.
* Guide analysts on case investigations, STR quality, screening decisions and escalation standards, while supporting ongoing training and capability development.

What we're looking for
  
  

* Mandatory: CAMS certification from ACAMS.
* 5–8 years of overall professional experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on AML/CFT experience in a VDA platform, bank, NBFC, payments company, brokerage or a comparable regulated financial services environment.
* Strong working knowledge of PMLA, 2002, the Prevention of Money-laundering (Maintenance of Records) Rules, 2005, and FIU-IND's AML/CFT requirements for VDA SPs.
* A sound understanding of FATF Recommendations, particularly Recommendations 15 and 16, and their relevance to virtual asset activities.
* Practical experience in transaction monitoring, suspicious transaction investigations and STR preparation and filing.
* Experience handling law enforcement requests, regulatory information requests and time-sensitive compliance matters.
* The ability to analyse transaction data, identify patterns and draw meaningful conclusions using Excel and, preferably, SQL or similar data analysis tools.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear investigation reports, regulatory responses and management updates.
* Good judgement, attention to detail and the ability to independently manage complex cases while guiding junior team members.

Good to have
  
  

* Hands-on experience with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis Reactor/KYT, TRM Labs or Elliptic.
* Experience working with transaction monitoring, screening or case management systems, including rule configuration, threshold optimisation and control testing.
* Exposure to Travel Rule implementation and interactions with counterparty VASPs.
* Experience with virtual asset regulatory frameworks outside India, including VARA (Dubai) or CBB (Bahrain).
* Additional certifications such as CCAS, CFE or ICA qualifications.

**Location:**
Bengaluru (Hybrid)
  
  
**Experience:**
5–8 years, including at least 3 years of hands-on AML/CFT experience
  
  
**Certification:**
CAMS (ACAMS) – Mandatory
  
  
**Life at PeepalCo**

* We take great pride in what we do and are committed to our mission. And we have a lot of fun while at it!Here’s how we do things at PeepalCo:Customer-first: That’s the North Star. Everything we do is to make our users’ investment experience better and simplified.
* Ownership: We don’t sport lab coats, but we experiment—a lot. And we take ownership. We even have a catchphrase for this: Think big, fail fast, and build better.
* Data-driven: The source of truth. Simple as that.
* Fun: PS5, anyone? Or do you prefer Foosball? Or perhaps Carrom? And yes, our HR team has a whole list of activities: Disco nights, offsites, gift boxes, and more!
* Speaking of lists, the perks and benefits are so extensive, this space isn’t enough. Here are a few:Parenthood: Up to 8 months of Maternity leave and 1 month of Paternity leave
* Gender Reassignment Surgery: Be the best version of you! We’ll support you and reimburse your medical bill.

*Disclaimer: We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building a respectful and empowering work environment for all people to freely express themselves amongst colleagues who embrace diversity in all respects. Including fresh voices and unique points of view in all aspects of our business not only creates an environment where we can all grow and thrive but also increases our potential to produce work that better represents—and resonates with—the world around us.*

title: Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – Income Tax
description:
**Job Description – Income Tax Advisory, Litigation & Compliance**

**Position:**
Senior Executive / Assistant Manager – Income Tax

**Experience:**
2–5 Years

**Qualification:**
Chartered Accountant (CA) / CA Inter / Commerce Graduate or Postgraduate with relevant Income Tax experience

**Location:**
Bengaluru

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Organisation:**
KASP & Associates – Chartered Accountants

1. About the Role

We are looking for a technically competent and proactive professional to handle Income Tax advisory, departmental assessments, litigation, corporate tax compliance and international taxation support for a diverse client portfolio. The role involves interpreting tax laws, advising on business transactions, managing departmental proceedings, identifying tax risks and improving tax compliance practices. Candidates should have practical knowledge of the Income-tax Act, 1961 and the Income-tax Act, 2025, applicable Rules and Forms, and be able to independently manage assignments.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Income Tax Advisory & Technical Research**

* Advise on corporate taxation, business income, capital gains, deductions, exemptions, disallowances and other direct tax matters.
* Analyse tax implications of business restructuring, share transfers, slump sales, related-party transactions and other commercial arrangements.
* Advise on TDS/TCS applicability, withholding tax obligations and compliance requirements.
* Research statutory provisions, Rules, notifications, circulars, CBDT instructions and judicial precedents; prepare tax opinions, technical notes and advisory reports.
* Identify tax exposures and recommend tax planning and risk-mitigation measures.

**B. Income Tax Litigation & Departmental Proceedings**

* Handle income tax notices, intimations, show-cause notices and other departmental communications; draft replies, submissions, objections and representations.
* Assist with appeals before the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals) and other appellate forums, as applicable, along with rectification and stay-of-demand applications.
* Analyse assessment and appellate orders, identify legal and factual issues, and recommend suitable courses of action.
* Track litigation status, tax demands, statutory deadlines and appeal timelines.
* Handle relevant proceedings under the Income-tax Act, 1961 and the Income-tax Act, 2025.

**C. Assessments, Scrutiny & Reassessment Proceedings**

* Handle scrutiny assessments, reassessments and other departmental proceedings, including responses to information requests and notices.
* Review financial statements, books of accounts, tax computations and supporting records to identify discrepancies and potential tax adjustments.
* Assist with faceless assessment and appeal proceedings through the Income Tax portal.
* Handle matters involving additions and disallowances, unexplained credits or investments, capital gains and other tax adjustments.
* Support clients during departmental inquiries and verification proceedings; assess potential tax, interest and penalty exposure and recommend responses.

**D. Corporate Tax Compliance & Tax Reviews**

* Review tax computations, advance tax, self-assessment tax and overall tax liabilities.
* Prepare, review and assist with Income Tax Returns for companies, LLPs, firms, trusts and individuals, as applicable, and review tax audit reports and reporting requirements.
* Review TDS/TCS returns, challan payments, tax credit reconciliations and withholding tax compliance.
* Analyse Form 26AS, AIS and TIS to identify discrepancies; review MAT/AMT, depreciation, brought-forward losses, deductions and other tax adjustments, where applicable.
* Track statutory due dates and ensure timely completion of compliance assignments.

**E. Lower TDS Deduction Certificates & International Taxation**

* Handle applications for lower or nil TDS deduction certificates, including applications under Section 197 of the Income-tax Act, 1961 and corresponding provisions under the Income-tax Act, 2025, wherever applicable.
* Prepare supporting tax computations and documentation, and coordinate with the Income Tax Department on application status, clarifications and follow-ups.
* Review Tax Residency Certificates (TRCs), Form 10F and documents required for benefits under applicable Double Taxation Avoidance Agreements (DTAAs).
* Analyse withholding tax on payments to non-residents, including interest, royalty and fees for technical services; review treaty eligibility, applicable rates and documentation.
* Research international tax matters and identify issues requiring specialist advice.

**F. Transfer Pricing**

* Have a working understanding of transfer pricing provisions, associated enterprises, international and specified domestic transactions, and the arm’s-length principle.
* Identify transactions requiring transfer pricing analysis or documentation and understand Form 3CEB requirements and applicable timelines.
* Coordinate with clients and specialists on benchmarking studies, transfer pricing reports and related compliance.

**G. Implementation of the Income-tax Act, 2025**

* Develop and maintain working knowledge of the Income-tax Act, 2025 and Income-tax Rules, 2026.
* Understand key changes from the Income-tax Act, 1961, including provisions, section references, procedures, Rules and Forms, and apply transitional provisions to earlier tax years where relevant.
* Update checklists, templates, working papers and SOPs; assist with revised tax computation, return preparation and compliance processes.
* Monitor amendments, CBDT notifications, circulars and clarifications affecting assignments.

**H. Tax Risk Management, Policies & Best Practices**

* Conduct periodic Income Tax health checks and compliance reviews; identify gaps in tax positions, documentation, withholding controls and statutory reporting.
* Develop or improve tax compliance policies, SOPs, checklists and internal review mechanisms for TDS/TCS, payments, return filing and reconciliations.
* Review significant transactions and contracts from an Income Tax perspective and recommend preventive measures to minimise tax exposure, interest, penalties and litigation.
* Maintain tax compliance calendars, assessment trackers, litigation registers and supporting documentation.

**I. Client Management & Team Coordination**

* Independently manage client engagements and ensure timely delivery of assignments.
* Liaise with clients to understand transactions, obtain information and explain tax implications.
* Coordinate with accounting, audit, GST and other internal teams on cross-functional matters.
* Maintain assessment files, litigation records and working papers; update clients and reporting partners on progress, pending information, tax exposures and key deadlines.
* Support junior team members in research, documentation and compliance reviews, as required.

3. Required Skills & Competencies

* Strong working knowledge of the Income-tax Act, 1961 and Income-tax Act, 2025, with applicable Rules and Forms.
* Practical experience in Income Tax advisory, assessments, scrutiny proceedings and litigation support.
* Hands-on exposure to lower or nil TDS certificate applications and departmental follow-ups.
* Working knowledge of TRCs, Form 10F, DTAA provisions and non-resident withholding tax requirements.
* Fair understanding of transfer pricing, associated enterprises and arm’s-length pricing.
* Good understanding of corporate taxation, capital gains, business taxation and TDS/TCS.
* Strong drafting, analytical, problem-solving and legal research skills.
* Familiarity with the Income Tax e-filing portal and faceless assessment procedures.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and preparation of tax computations, reports and written submissions.
* Strong client communication, assignment management and documentation skills, with the ability to identify risks and recommend practical solutions.

4. Preferred Candidate Profile

* CA / CA Inter / relevant commerce professional with 2–5 years of practical Income Tax experience.
* Experience in a Chartered Accountancy firm, tax consultancy or professional services environment.
* Exposure to scrutiny assessments, tax notices and replies, appellate proceedings, lower TDS certificate applications, TRC/DTAA documentation, corporate tax reviews, tax audits and TDS/TCS compliance.
* Working knowledge of the Income-tax Act, 2025 and Income-tax Rules, 2026, or the ability to quickly understand and implement the new framework.
* Basic or working knowledge of transfer pricing; specialist-level experience is not mandatory.
* A proactive professional who can independently manage assignments and client relationships and improve tax compliance processes.

5. What We Offer

* Exposure to diverse industries and complex Income Tax matters.
* Opportunities to work on tax advisory, assessments, litigation and international taxation assignments.
* Direct interaction with clients and senior professionals.
* Opportunities to develop technical expertise, drafting skills and independent assignment-management capabilities.
* A professional environment focused on continuous learning and career growth.

Interested candidates can share their resume along with their current CTC at contact@kaspglobal.com.

India

**Job Summary**
The Director – Legal will lead and scale Lowe’s global Contracts Centre of Excellence from India, driving enterprise-wide contracting strategy, governance, risk management, and operational excellence. This role will oversee end-to-end contract lifecycle management across all business functions and geographies, with a strong focus on global (including US) contracting. The Director will lead a team of contract professionals and will be responsible for establishing standardized contracting frameworks, enhancing contract governance, mitigating legal and commercial risks, and enabling business growth through efficient and compliant contracting practices.
  
  
This role requires strategic leadership, global stakeholder engagement, program development, and building scalable processes that support Lowe’s business objectives and risk posture.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**
**Core Responsibilities:**
**Contracts COE Strategy & Leadership**

* Define and execute the vision and strategy for the Contracts COE aligned with global Legal and business priorities.
* Build and scale a centralized contracting model supporting multiple business functions (procurement, merchandising, technology, HR, supply chain, etc.).
* Establish governance frameworks, operating models, and KPIs for contracting excellence.
* Drive continuous improvement through benchmarking, automation, and best practices.
* Serve as a strategic advisor to senior leadership across Legal, Procurement, Finance, Technology, and business teams.
* Collaborate with global stakeholders to align contracting practices and drive consistency.
* Influence decision-making by balancing legal risk with business objectives.

**Contract Lifecycle Management & Governance**

* Lead the integration of a cutting-edge Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) tool, setting a new global standard for how we leverage technology to drive speed, accuracy, and compliance.
* Oversee end-to-end contract lifecycle management (CLM) including drafting, review, negotiation, execution, and post-contract management.
* Ensure strong contract governance, version control, audit readiness, and repository management.
* Lead CLM tool strategy, implementation, and adoption across the enterprise.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate legal, financial, operational, and regulatory risks in contracts.
* Ensure alignment with global compliance, regulatory requirements, and internal policies.
* Partner closely with Compliance, Risk, Audit, and Legal teams to embed risk-based contracting practices.
* Establish controls and monitoring mechanisms for contract compliance and audits.
* Provide strategic oversight and guidance on high-value, complex, and global contracts, especially US contracts.
* Support negotiation strategies involving indemnities, liability, IP, data privacy, and regulatory provisions.

* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing Contracts COE team, including Senior Manager – Contracts.
* Drive talent development, succession planning, and capability enhancement.
* Establish performance metrics, quality standards, and delivery excellence frameworks.
* Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
* Provide periodic reporting and insights to senior leadership on contracting risks, performance, and trends.
* Present key metrics, risks, and strategic initiatives to Legal leadership and business stakeholders.
* Drive transparency and data-driven decision-making in contracting operations.

**Years Of Experience**
15+ years of experience working in a Leadership position within the legal department of a multi-national company.

**Required Minimum Qualifications**
LLB/LLM graduate.
