title: Associate Partners / Sr Advocate / Advocates
description:
At Assured Justice LLP, you will not merely take up a job you will step into a practice that challenges you, sharpens you, and positions you to emerge as a complete litigator. Our firm offers a rare and demanding canvas: a diverse caseload spanning civil property disputes, constitutional and writ matters, criminal litigation, matrimonial proceedings, insolvency, consumer and RERA disputes, labour law, and high-stakes commercial work across courts in Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, and Kerala.

This is a role designed for advocates who seek ownership, not observation.

Key responsibilities and opportunities:

* End-to-end client handling — You will own matters from the first client consultation through drafting, filing, arguing, and final disposal. No siloed work, no peripheral involvement. You will be the face of the file, the strategist behind it, and the voice in court.
* Direct client relationships — You will build, manage, and retain your own client relationships. The firm actively encourages associates to develop independent rapport with clients, attend conferences directly, and become the trusted advisor rather than a back-office presence.
* Complex, career-defining litigation — Expect to work on constitutional challenges, multi-generational property disputes, fraud and natural justice matters, cross-border enforcement, and litigation before the High Courts and the Supreme Court of India. Every brief is an opportunity to stretch.
* Drafting that stands out in court — You will be mentored to produce pleadings, petitions, written submissions, and legal notices that are precise, well-reasoned, and citation-rich — the kind of work that earns judicial attention.
* Advocacy and negotiation at every forum — From trial courts and tribunals to appellate and constitutional benches, you will argue, cross-examine, and negotiate on behalf of clients at every stage.
* Independent growth and networking — Assured Justice LLP believes in building advocates, not employees. You will be encouraged to attend bar events, build referral networks, publish, speak, and cultivate your professional identity. Your name will appear on the memo of parties. Your reputation will be yours to carry forward.
* Collaboration with a multi-office practice — Work alongside colleagues across our Bengaluru, Hosur, Krishnagiri, Trivandrum, Cochin, and Chennai offices, giving you exposure to multiple jurisdictions, languages, and legal cultures within a single firm.
* The challenge is real. The hours are demanding. The standards are high. But so is the growth — and for an advocate who is hungry to build a serious, independent, courtroom-forward practice, there are few better places to do it.

About us

Assured Justice LLP is a technology-driven law firm building one of India's most ambitious legal networks. We combine the rigour of traditional legal practice with the reach, speed, and efficiency of a modern, tech-enabled platform and we are scaling fast.

Our practice spans the full spectrum of contemporary legal work: Family Law, Real Estate, Mergers & Acquisitions, Civil Litigation, Corporate Law, NCLT and insolvency, CAT, Consumer Courts, Labour & Employment Law, and Intellectual Property — Patents, Trademarks, and Copyright. Our clients range from individuals and families to corporates, institutions, and high-growth businesses.

Over the next 36 months, we intend to grow into a network of 30 offices across India. That is not a projection — it is a plan. And it is a plan that creates an extraordinary runway of opportunity for the right legal professionals to grow with us.

We are looking for advocates with fire in them — lawyers who want to build real practice, not watch it from the sidelines. Our associates take full, end-to-end ownership of their matters: first client meeting to final order. That means conducting client conferences independently, drafting pleadings and petitions in your own hand, appearing in court, cross-examining witnesses, and arguing matters on your feet. No shadow work. No invisible contribution. Your name on the memo, your voice in court, your client relationship to build.

If you have the zest for learning, the appetite for ownership, and the ambition to grow into a complete, independent litigator — Assured Justice LLP is the platform built for you.

title: Head (Senior Manager) - Industrial Relations
description:
**About The Team**
You will join the Security & Investigations team within Fulfilment & Experience (F&E) at Meesho. F&E is the operational and technological backbone powering India's cost-efficient, reliable and scalable e-commerce network, serving 100M+ monthly active users. From enabling Valmo's distributed logistics network to building scalable fulfilment and experience platforms, F&E operates at the intersection of technology, operations and network innovation.
  
  
Within F&E, the Security & Investigations team safeguards the integrity and resilience of this network. The team investigates shipment loss, pilferage, fraud and misconduct, oversees physical security across operating sites, and coordinates with law enforcement and other stakeholders where required. Working closely with Operations, HR, Legal and logistics partners, the team helps keep the network secure, compliant and resilient.
  
  
**About The Role**
Valmo's operating network is powered by a large and diverse workforce spanning sort centres, hubs and last-mile operations. A significant portion of this workforce is engaged through logistics partners and other workforce arrangements, creating a complex industrial-relations environment across multiple locations and states.
  
  
As Head – Industrial Relations, you will own the Industrial Relations (IR) charter for the operating network, within the Security & Investigations function, and work closely with HR, Legal, Operations and partner leadership. Your mandate will be to build a stable, compliant and scalable workforce-relations framework that prevents avoidable disputes, enables fair and timely resolution of workforce issues, and provides strong governance when matters escalate.
  
  
The role combines strategic IR leadership with significant field engagement. You will build early-warning mechanisms, manage worker and union relationships, oversee dispute and disciplinary processes, strengthen partner workforce compliance, engage with labour authorities, and create playbooks and governance mechanisms that can scale with the network.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
**Own IR strategy and governance.**
Build and continuously evolve a national IR framework covering workforce relations, grievance management, dispute prevention, statutory compliance, worker/union engagement, escalation and resolution.
  
  
**Build workforce intelligence and early-warning mechanisms.**
Track workforce sentiment, grievances, absenteeism, wage-related concerns, shift and working-condition issues, emerging worker representation or union activity, and other indicators of potential disruption across the network.
  
  
**Prevent and manage industrial disputes.**
Develop structured approaches to prevent disputes and lead the response to strikes, work stoppages, protests, gheraos and other workforce disruptions. Engage with worker representatives and union leaders and coordinate with Operations, HR, Legal, partners, local administration, labour authorities and law enforcement, as appropriate.
  
  
**Bring IR rigour to investigations.**
Partner with Security & Investigations, HR and Legal on cases involving employees or partner workers, including theft, fraud, misconduct and policy violations. Ensure due process, appropriate documentation and legally sound decision-making.
  
  
**Govern disciplinary processes.**
Oversee show-cause notices, domestic enquiries and disciplinary actions, ensuring that processes are fair, consistent, timely and legally defensible under applicable law, standing orders and organisational policy.
  
  
**Drive partner workforce compliance.**
Establish and monitor governance over logistics partners covering contract labour requirements, wage and benefits compliance, statutory registrations, working hours, worker documentation, grievance mechanisms and other applicable labour requirements. Drive timely corrective action and escalation where gaps are identified.
  
  
**Own government and authority engagement.**
Build effective working relationships with labour departments, labour commissioners, conciliation officers and other relevant government authorities. Represent the organisation in inspections, conciliation proceedings and hearings, in partnership with Legal, and coordinate with Security on matters requiring law-enforcement engagement.
  
  
**Build effective grievance and escalation channels.**
Design and strengthen mechanisms such as worker helplines, site-level committees, grievance forums and escalation paths so that workforce concerns are surfaced and resolved before they become formal disputes.
  
  
**Create scalable IR playbooks and capability.**
Develop SOPs, policies, escalation matrices and response playbooks for dispute management, investigation-linked disciplinary action, partner workforce issues and authority engagement. Train site leaders, partner supervisors, HR teams and security personnel on relevant IR practices and labour-law basics.
  
  
**Build IR analytics and leadership reporting.**
Establish dashboards and regular reviews covering incidents, disputes, grievances, compliance health, partner risks, resolution timelines, repeat issues and emerging trends. Translate these into clear insights and actions for senior leadership.
  
  
**Strengthen cross-functional governance.**
Establish clear interfaces between IR, HR, Legal, Operations, Security & Investigations and partner leadership, including decision rights, escalation threshold
  
  
**What You Will Need**

* 8–15 years of experience in industrial relations, employee relations, labour relations or labour-law compliance, preferably in large, distributed workforce environments.
* Experience in logistics, e-commerce, manufacturing, warehousing, retail, infrastructure or other large blue-collar and/or contract-workforce environments is strongly preferred.
* Deep working knowledge of applicable Indian labour and employment laws, including the Labour Codes and associated rules/notifications, contract labour requirements, industrial disputes, standing orders and relevant state-specific requirements.
* Practical experience applying labour law and IR principles on the ground across multiple sites and, ideally, multiple states.
* Proven experience handling industrial disputes, worker grievances, union/worker representative engagement, negotiations, strikes or work stoppages.
* Experience conducting or overseeing domestic enquiries and disciplinary proceedings, with a strong understanding of how employee investigations intersect with employment law and due process.
* Experience managing contract labour or partner workforce compliance, including audits, statutory requirements, wage-related compliance and remediation.
* Strong ability to engage with labour authorities, conciliation officers and other government stakeholders, preferably with experience representing an organisation in formal proceedings.
* Strong negotiation, conflict-resolution and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to remain calm, credible and objective in high-pressure situations.
* Ability to work effectively across HR, Legal, Operations, Security & Investigations and external partners, with sound judgement on ownership, escalation and confidentiality.
* Strong communication skills in English and Hindi. Proficiency in one or more regional languages is an advantage, particularly for workforce-heavy operating regions.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, including the ability to use workforce and incident data to identify patterns, risks and preventive actions.
* Willingness to travel extensively across operating locations and respond to sensitive on-ground situations at short notice.
* High integrity, discretion and maturity, with the ability to handle confidential matters and decisions that can materially affect employees and workers.
* A degree in law, HR, labour welfare, social work or a related discipline (LLB, MSW, MBA-HR or equivalent) is preferred.

**Role Characteristics**

* National scope with significant field engagement across the operating network.
* High level of cross-functional and external stakeholder interaction.
* Combination of strategic programme ownership, operational problem-solving and on-ground dispute management.
* Requires sound judgement, neutrality, confidentiality and the ability to balance business continuity with fair and compliant workforce practices.

description:
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
**About Third Party Risk**
The Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) team is accountable for defining, maintaining, and overseeing the third party risk framework, policy, and inventory in accordance with management expectations and best practices. We are focused on assessing and managing risks exposed through our relationships with third parties, adhering to regulatory guidance, and driving operational efficiencies across risk teams. TPRM is a regulatory obligation for Financial Services companies.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
We're looking for a Third Party Risk Analyst to join our growing team. This individual will support the ongoing operations of the existing framework for identifying, assessing, and managing third party risks to protect Stripe.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Conduct third party assessments while facilitating the process through closure.

* Prepare and continuously improve third party risk reporting for senior leaders, relevant stakeholders, and governance groups. ^
* Partner with the US TPRM team to drive execution and delivery of required procedures to maintain ongoing regulatory compliance operations for programs including the Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) and global outsourcing regimes.
* Work closely with internal teams at Stripe to coordinate procedures, gather inputs and handover to US TPRM.
* Maintain procedural documentation, driving consistency and alignment across our procedures.
* Identify opportunities to improve processes and contribute to scaling our program globally.
* Ability to escalate issues and risks to management upon identification.
* Be a part of building a brand new team for Stripe and leading the way towards a culture of compliance.

Who you are
  
  
We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* 3+ years of relevant experience in risk and compliance which could include third party, operational, enterprise, or other areas of risk and compliance management
* Self-disciplined, diligent, proactive, organized, and exceptionally detail oriented
* An extremely responsive and collaborative team-player
* User first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems
* Solution-oriented mindset with enthusiasm for establishing best practices
* Humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams
* A proven ability to build strong collaborative working relationships with business partners
* A proven ability to be a self starter capable of driving business results without significant supervision
* The ability to maintain high performance under tight timelines and a “roll up your sleeves” mindset to get any job done
* The ability to bring structure to ambiguous areas of opportunity and thrive in an unstructured, fast-moving environment
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Excellent problem-solving skills and demonstrated ability to work independently, analyze problems and data sets to make complex investigation decisions
* Independently analyze and evaluate information from various data sources to determine a course of action for a matched case
* Demonstrated experience partnering with cross-functional stakeholders
* Demonstrated history of taking on various types of challenging projects and producing results

**You Will Also Likely Have (not Required)**

* \* Strong knowledge of gSuite tools, Tableau and other data reporting tools including experience working with/analyzing data sets.

+ Knowledge in the fintech industry
+ The ability to be flexible and comfortable with changing requirements
+ A builder's mindset and a willingness to question assumptions and conventional wisdom
+ A passion for creating new systems and solving problems via infrastructure and automation
+ Eagerness to stay updated on emerging trends, regulations, and industry standards related to third party risk management and integrate them into Stripe's program

In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
  
  
We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
  
  
Apply now

**Our Culture**
PHINIA promotes and cultivates an inclusive culture and diverse perspectives, strives to maintain its reputation for excellence, thrives on the power of collaboration, and fosters the development of our talented employees. We believe in making a positive impact through our business and actions, and we take our collective responsibility seriously.

We offer a strong local presence and interesting global opportunities. Join us on this shared journey toward a brighter tomorrow.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
Responsible for governing the full lifecycle of Statements of Work (SOWs), Work Orders (WOs), Change Requests (CRs), and financial/operational compliance across PHINIA’s IT Managed Services ecosystem. This role partners closely with the IT Vendor Management Office (VMO), tower leads, and suppliers to ensure flawless operational execution, financial accuracy, and contractual discipline.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the end‑to‑end SOW lifecycle, including scoping, drafting, redlining, routing for approvals, acceptance criteria alignment, version control, and document repository hygiene.
* Enforce VMO governance & workflow discipline, ensuring no work begins without an approved PO/SOW, tracking WO/PO progression, maintaining VMO trackers, and driving adherence to approval paths.
* Administer contractual updates, aligning Change Requests, amendments, SIAM (Service Integration and Management) matrices, and cross‑functional roles & responsibilities across IT towers and suppliers.

title: Global Regulatory Packaging Compliance Leader
description:
**Job Description Summary**
The Global Regulatory Packaging Compliance Leader will be responsible for establishing and leading global packaging regulatory compliance across GE HealthCare business segments, product lines, and markets. This strategic role will proactively monitor existing and emerging packaging regulations, assess regulatory applicability and business impact, and translate complex regulatory requirements into actionable compliance strategies, technical requirements, and implementation plans.
  
  
As the global focal point for packaging regulatory compliance, the role will drive regulatory readiness, develop compliance governance frameworks, and provide early visibility into regulatory changes that could impact GE HealthCare products, packaging, manufacturing operations, and market access. The position will work closely with Regulatory Affairs, Product Compliance, Engineering, Packaging, Quality, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Sustainability, EHS, Logistics, and global leadership teams to ensure timely and effective regulatory implementation.
  
  
GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Roles and Responsibilities**

* Lead and establish a global packaging regulatory compliance framework across GE HealthCare business segments, products, and geographic markets.
* Monitor existing and emerging global packaging regulations, including the European Union Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation (PPWR), Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR), and applicable country-specific packaging, environmental, recycling, and waste management requirements.
* Conduct regulatory applicability assessments, evaluate business and operational impacts, and proactively communicate regulatory changes, compliance risks, and implementation priorities to relevant stakeholders and leadership.
* Interpret complex regulatory requirements and translate them into actionable technical, engineering, packaging, quality, sourcing, and business requirements.
* Develop and drive regulatory implementation roadmaps, compliance calendars, readiness assessments, and cross-functional action plans to support timely compliance.
* Lead and coordinate PPWR regulatory assessments, technical compliance activities, and implementation initiatives in collaboration with relevant global teams.
* Establish and maintain standardized regulatory compliance processes, procedures, governance mechanisms, and documentation requirements.
* Coordinate the preparation and maintenance of regulatory declarations, technical documentation, compliance assessments, change notifications, and supporting evidence.
* Develop and maintain a global packaging regulatory risk register, identify compliance gaps, and coordinate risk mitigation and corrective action plans.
* Establish regulatory compliance KPIs, dashboards, and monitoring mechanisms to track regulatory readiness, implementation progress, and compliance risks.
* Coordinate EPR-related compliance activities, including country-specific registration, reporting, documentation, and clarification of functional ownership and accountability.
* Partner with Regulatory Affairs, Product Compliance, Engineering, Packaging COE, Quality, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Sustainability, EHS, Logistics, and suppliers to drive consistent regulatory compliance practices globally.
* Develop and deliver regulatory training, compliance communications, and awareness programs to strengthen organizational understanding of packaging regulatory obligations.
* Provide regular updates and recommendations to global leadership on regulatory developments, business risks, compliance status, and implementation progress.
* Drive continuous improvement and standardization of packaging regulatory compliance practices while supporting uninterrupted business operations and global market access.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, Environmental Science, or a related technical discipline.
* Minimum 15 years or more of professional experience in Regulatory Affairs, Regulatory Compliance, Product Compliance, or a related regulated industry function.
* Experience in Packaging Regulatory Affairs or Regulatory Compliance within the medical device, MedTech, healthcare technology, or other highly regulated manufacturing industries.
* Strong experience interpreting, assessing, and implementing regulatory requirements across multiple countries or geographic regions.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex regulatory requirements into practical business processes, technical requirements, and implementation plans.
* Experience leading regulatory compliance initiatives and coordinating activities across global, cross-functional teams.
* Strong understanding of regulatory risk assessment, compliance documentation, governance processes, and regulatory change management.
* Proven ability to independently manage complex compliance programs, establish priorities, and drive implementation through cross-functional stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and influencing skills, with the ability to engage effectively with senior leadership and global teams.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and risk-based decision-making capabilities.

**Desired Characteristics**

* Master's degree in Packaging Engineering, Regulatory Affairs, Environmental Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Knowledge of global packaging regulations, including EU PPWR, Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR), packaging waste management, recycling requirements, and environmental compliance obligations.
* Experience in packaging regulatory compliance, packaging engineering, packaging materials, or product labeling requirements.
* Familiarity with applicable ISO packaging and labeling standards.
* Experience developing regulatory compliance frameworks, governance processes, implementation roadmaps, risk registers, KPIs, and compliance dashboards.
* Understanding of packaging sustainability regulations, carbon footprint reduction initiatives, hazardous material restrictions, and circular economy requirements.
* Experience supporting regulatory change notifications, compliance assessments, technical documentation, and regulatory reporting.
* Ability to anticipate emerging regulatory risks, provide practical recommendations, and influence decisions across a global organization.
* Demonstrated regulatory judgment, cross-functional collaboration, documentation rigor, and a continuous improvement mindset.

Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

title: Senior Compliance Engineer
description:
**About Hevo**

Hevo is a fully-managed, no-code data pipeline platform that helps organizations move, transform, and activate their data in real time. With 150+ pre-built, battle-tested connectors, Hevo lets data teams focus on insights instead of pipeline maintenance — trusted by 2,000+ organizations globally to keep their data flowing reliably, securely, and in compliance with standards like SOC 2, GDPR, CCPA, DORA and HIPAA.

**About the Role**

As Hevo's enterprise customer base grows, security and compliance reviews are an increasingly visible part of how deals get done. We're looking for a Senior Compliance Engineer to own our GRC program end-to-end — audits, risk, vendor management, and policy — and to be the technical face of security and compliance to customers and prospects during due diligence. Strong communication is essential: this role is regularly customer-facing and needs to translate technical detail into language that builds trust.

**What You'll Do**

* Own and operate our compliance programs (SOC 2, GDPR, HIPAA, DORA, DPDP as applicable) end-to-end — control implementation, evidence collection, and audit management
* Be the primary point of contact for external auditors; manage audit timelines and evidence collection
* Own the risk assessment program — identify, assess, score, track, and report risks via a risk register
* Manage vendor and third-party risk assessments and due diligence
* Respond to customer and prospect security questionnaires (RFPs, due-diligence requests, trust-portal access) with accuracy and speed — a high-visibility, customer-facing part of this role
* Support Sales and Customer Success on security & compliance calls with prospects and customers, translating technical controls into business language
* Draft, maintain, and drive review of security policies and procedures
* Track and report on compliance posture and drift to leadership
* Partner with engineering and security teams to close compliance gaps pragmatically, balancing rigor with velocity
* Use GRC tooling (e.g., Sprinto, Vanta, Drata, or similar) to automate evidence collection and monitoring

**What We're Looking For — Must-Haves**

* 4+ years in GRC/compliance engineering or related roles (compliance, audit, information security)
* Hands-on experience running SOC 2/ISO 27001 (or similar) audits end-to-end
* Strong understanding of data protection & privacy — GDPR, HIPAA, PII/PHI handling
* Proven ability to manage vendor/third-party risk assessments
* Excellent written and verbal communication — comfortable presenting to and negotiating with external customers, auditors, and executives
* Experience responding to customer security questionnaires / RFPs
* Working knowledge of cloud environments (AWS) — enough to assess and discuss controls with engineering
* Strong organizational skills — able to manage multiple audits and timelines independently

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with GRC automation platforms (Sprinto, Vanta, Drata, OneTrust)
* Relevant certifications (CISA, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer, CIPP)
* Experience in a B2B SaaS company handling enterprise customer data

**About The Role**
We are looking for an Open Source Software Compliance Coordinator with experience in

,

, and open-source license compliance. The role involves identifying open-source components, assessing license obligations and vulnerabilities, and helping development teams maintain compliance across software applications.
  
  
**Job Description**
You will work with application delivery teams and security stakeholders to coordinate open-source compliance activities, review scan results, and address licensing and vulnerability risks. The role also involves supporting compliance audits, improving DevSecOps practices, and developing training materials to strengthen organization-wide security awareness.

* Review Software Composition Analysis (SCA) scan results and help teams address identified risks.

* Support risk assessment and acceptance workflows for non-compliant licenses.
* Coordinate source-code scans and assess code or package origins, including potential plagiarism.
* Review Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) data and support package and snippet scanning.
* Develop compliance training materials and educate teams on open-source license categories.
* Collaborate with security and engineering teams to improve DevSecOps and application security practices.
* Track and communicate compliance status, vulnerabilities, and improvement opportunities to technical teams and management.

**Required Skills**

* Open-source software compliance and license management.
* Application Security and Software Composition Analysis (SCA).
* Hands-on experience with SCA tools, including Black Duck or Sonatype IQ.
* Understanding of open-source license obligations, risk acceptance, and compliance workflows.
* Knowledge of package scanning, snippet scanning, and SBOM generation and review.
* Ability to identify open-source code or package origins and assess potential code reuse issues.
* Strong written communication, presentation, and training skills.

**Preferred / Good To Have**

* Software engineering experience in one or more programming languages.
* IT architecture knowledge and experience with CI/CD pipelines.
* Understanding of OWASP Top 10 vulnerabilities and OWASP ASVS requirements.
* Familiarity with security maturity frameworks such as OWASP SAMM or BSIMM.
* Experience implementing application security testing processes and tools.
* Awareness of the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) or similar regulations.
* Experience analyzing and improving product security at scale.

Mandatory Skills
  
  

* Application Security – Black Duck / Sonatype IQ

Candidate Profile
  
  
The ideal candidate will have at least four years of experience in open-source software compliance, with a strong technical understanding of application security and software licensing. They should be comfortable working with development teams, advising stakeholders, communicating compliance risks, and driving security awareness through education.
  
  
Benefits Package
  
  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Opportunities for professional growth and development
* A collaborative and inclusive work environment
* The opportunity to work on exciting and challenging projects with leading clients

**Job Summary**
The Senior Manager, Legal (GTS India) will support Walmart Global Tech Services by providing strategic legal advisory and end-to-end contracting support across technology, procurement, and business functions.
  
  
This role will partner closely with global stakeholders to enable business priorities while ensuring robust legal governance, proactive risk mitigation, and strict adherence to ethics, compliance, and regulatory standards.
  
  
The role will also drive legal operations excellence, standardisation, and scalable processes to support a high-volume, global contracting environment, while reinforcing a strong culture of integrity and ethical decision-making across all engagements.
  
  
**About The Team**
The GTS Legal team supports enterprise technology, procurement, and digital transformation initiatives globally. The team plays a critical role in enabling secure, compliant, and scalable business operations by managing legal risks, strengthening governance frameworks, and upholding the highest standards of ethics and compliance while partnering with cross-functional stakeholders across markets.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Legal Advisory & Business Partnership

Act as a trusted legal advisor to GTS stakeholders across technology, sourcing, and business teams
  
  
Provide guidance on legal, regulatory, risk, and ethics & compliance considerations related to technology and commercial transactions
  
  
Interpret legal frameworks and deliver pragmatic, business-aligned solutions while ensuring alignment with organisational values and ethical standards
  
  

* Technology & Commercial Contracting

Lead drafting, review, and negotiation of complex technology and commercial contracts (SaaS, cloud, licensing, NDAs, MSAs, SOWs, vendor agreements)
  
  
Ensure all contracts adhere to company policies, ethical standards, and compliance requirements, including anti-corruption and fair business practices
  
  
Support high-value, high-risk contracting engagements with global stakeholders
  
  
Standardise contracting processes through playbooks, templates, and clause libraries, embedding compliance and ethical safeguards
  
  

* Risk, Compliance, Ethics & Governance

Identify, assess, and mitigate legal and regulatory risks across global technology operations
  
  
Ensure adherence to data privacy, cybersecurity, anti-corruption laws, and global compliance frameworks
  
  
Partner closely with Ethics & Compliance, Internal Audit, and Investigations teams on governance reviews, policy enforcement, and issue resolution
  
  
Champion a culture of integrity and ethical conduct, proactively advising stakeholders on risk avoidance and responsible decision-making
  
  
Support internal investigations, whistleblower matters, and compliance reviews as required
  
  

* Legal Operations & Transformation

Drive legal ops maturity through adoption of CLM tools, automation, and streamlined workflows
  
  
Embed compliance checkpoints, audit trails, and ethical controls within contracting and legal processes
  
  
Build scalable frameworks to improve turnaround time, efficiency, and service quality
  
  
Develop dashboards and reporting for contract risk, cycle time, and compliance and ethics metrics
  
  

* Stakeholder & Global Collaboration

Collaborate with global legal teams, business leaders, sourcing/procurement, and external counsel
  
  
Partner with global Ethics & Compliance teams to ensure consistent application of standards across geographies
  
  
Manage cross-border legal matters and ensure alignment with global regulatory and ethical standards
  
  
Lead and contribute to legal and compliance transformation initiatives within GTS
  
  
What You’ll Bring
  
  
12–15+ years of experience in legal, with strong focus on technology and commercial contracting
  
  
Proven expertise in drafting, reviewing, and negotiating complex technology agreements (SaaS, cloud, IT services, licensing)
  
  
Strong understanding of global regulatory frameworks including ethics, compliance, data privacy, and anti-corruption laws
  
  
Demonstrated experience working closely with compliance, audit, and risk teams
  
  
Experience working in global capability centres / shared services / multinational environments
  
  
Exposure to legal operations, CLM platforms, and process transformation initiatives
  
  
Strong stakeholder management with ability to influence senior business leaders
  
  
Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and risk assessment skills with a high degree of integrity and ethical judgement
  
  
**Preferred Qualifications**
LLB / LLM from a recognised institution
  
  
Experience in technology, retail, e-commerce, or digital transformation ecosystems
  
  
Familiarity with GDPR, IT Act, cross-border data transfer regulations
  
  
Prior experience in high-volume contracting COEs
  
  
Exposure to ethics & compliance programmes, investigations, or governance frameworks
  
  
Leadership Expectations
  
  
Demonstrates strong business acumen and strategic thinking
  
  
Operates with a risk-intelligent, ethics-first, and compliance-driven mindset
  
  
Drives collaboration across global teams and influences stakeholders
  
  
Champions integrity, accountability, and ethical decision-making in all business interactions
  
  
Acts as a role model for compliance culture and responsible business conduct
  
  
Leads process excellence, governance rigor, and continuous improvement initiatives
  
  
**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.
  
  
We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
  
  
Flexible, hybrid work
  
  
We use a hybrid way of working with primary in office presence coupled with an optimal mix of virtual presence. We use our campuses to collaborate and be together in person, as business needs require and for development and networking opportunities. This approach helps us make quicker decisions, remove location barriers across our global team, be more flexible in our personal lives.
  
  
**Benefits**
Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
  
  
Belonging
  
  
We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
  
  
At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.
  
  
Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
Walmart, Inc., is an Equal Opportunities Employer – By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people.

title: Senior Legal Associate - MSP
description:
**Senior Legal Associate – MSP**

**About the Role**

We are seeking a Senior Legal Associate – MSP to join our global legal team and provide legal and compliance support across our Managed Service Provider (MSP) operations. This role combines commercial contracting, supplier compliance, risk assessment, and team leadership, supporting a diverse international supplier network and contingent workforce programs.

The successful candidate will play a key role in drafting and negotiating supplier agreements, leading compliance reviews, supporting supplier onboarding decisions, and mentoring junior legal professionals. This is an exciting opportunity for a commercially minded legal professional who enjoys working across multiple jurisdictions and collaborating with global stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Draft, review, negotiate, and manage supplier agreements, amendments, and related legal documentation.
* Provide legal support on MSP and second-tier supplier matters across multiple regions.
* Conduct and oversee supplier compliance reviews covering employment, tax, immigration, insurance, data protection, sanctions, anti-bribery, and modern slavery requirements.
* Review client contractual obligations and translate flow-down requirements into supplier documentation and onboarding processes.
* Assess legal and commercial risks associated with subcontracting models, supplier structures, and extended supply chains.
* Support implementation of new MSP programs and operational changes by identifying jurisdiction-specific legal requirements.
* Develop and maintain compliance guidance, legal templates, country-specific requirements, and training materials.
* Partner closely with Supply Chain, Account Management, Finance, PMO, Compliance, and regional Legal teams.
* Advise suppliers on onboarding requirements and regulatory obligations.
* Supervise, mentor, and develop Legal Executives while reviewing work quality and workload allocation.
* Support audit activities and remediation initiatives while driving continuous process improvements.

**What You'll Bring**

* Law degree from an accredited university.
* Minimum 4 years' experience in commercial law, supplier contracting, compliance, staffing, workforce solutions, MSP, or supply chain legal environments.
* Strong experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating commercial and supplier agreements.
* Working knowledge of MSP, contingent workforce, recruitment, staffing, subcontracting, or supplier-management models.
* Understanding of compliance and due diligence requirements, including employment law, tax, immigration, data protection, sanctions, anti-bribery, and modern slavery regulations.
* Experience conducting legal research across multiple jurisdictions and translating legal requirements into practical business guidance.
* Demonstrated experience mentoring, coaching, or supervising junior team members.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* High levels of professionalism, commercial awareness, integrity, and sound judgment.

**Why Join Us?**

* Work with a global legal team supporting international workforce solutions programs.
* Gain exposure to complex multi-jurisdictional legal and compliance matters.
* Lead meaningful projects that influence supplier governance and risk management.
* Develop leadership skills through mentoring and team supervision.
* Be part of a collaborative and dynamic environment focused on continuous improvement and operational excellence.

**Apply today and help shape legal and compliance excellence across a global MSP ecosystem.**

title: Senior Medical Device Regulatory Policy Lead
description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Bengaluru, Karnataka, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Master's degree in Science, Engineering, Software, Law, Public Health, Public Policy, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of professional experience in regulatory affairs.
* Experience with medical device standards and Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) frameworks, and monitoring regulatory developments and composing authoritative policy briefs.
* Experience to lead government agency engagement outside of submission advocacy strategies and educate global health authorities on modern oversight frameworks for AI.
* Experience working cross-functionally with clinical, quality, and engineering teams to align product strategy with regulatory requirements.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience in engaging with Regulatory agencies outside of submission.
* Experience within digital health or AI policy and understanding of generative models in clinical settings.
* Previous participation and proven effectiveness in international regulatory/industry forums/standards organizations.
* Track record of contributing to international standards (ISO/IEC, AAMI).

**About The Job**
As a Senior Regulatory Policy Specialist reporting directly to the Senior Director of Digital Health Strategy, you will help drive Google’s advocacy in the US for medical device features. Serving as an essential partner and a catalyst, you will facilitate executive-level agency relationships, prepare leadership for high-level engagements, and represent company technical positions in industry coalitions, public consultations, and standards bodies. Additionally, you will collaborate closely with internal stakeholders across Clinical, Engineering, and Government Affairs to translate evolving global health policy into clear, proactive product guidance that accelerates safe, compliant market access.
  
  
Google for Health is a company-wide effort to help billions of people be healthier. We work toward this direction by meeting people in their everyday moments and empowering them to stay healthy and partnering with care teams to provide more accurate and accessible care. Our teams are applying our expertise and technology to improve health outcomes globally – with high-quality information and tools to help people manage their health and wellbeing, solutions to transform care delivery, research to catalyze the use of artificial intelligence for the screening and diagnosis of disease, and data and insights to the public health community.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and facilitate engagements with Indian health authorities such as the CDSCO, supporting leadership during high-level meetings and representing Google's regulatory positions where executive presence is needed.
* Monitor and analyze India’s legislative, statutory, and medical device regulatory developments related to digital health, healthcare AI, and Software as a Medical Device (SaMD).
* Represent Google across key US industry trade associations and standards bodies, including CTA Health, WHO-India, APAC med, and ISO committees, and other advocacy groups to build collaborative policy coalitions.
* Liaise with internal engineering, clinical, quality, and government affairs teams to align device feature claims with necessary clinical evidence and support US marketing authorizations.
* Provide regulatory policy counsel to leadership and collaborate with regional leads to ensure US policy initiatives harmonize with global digital health launches.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. title: Compliance Manager
description:
**Overview**
Drive business-led compliance across India and South Asia and help enable responsible growth through effective risk management, collaboration, and innovation.
  
  
Compliance Manager will help foster a culture of compliance across MCAPS India and South Asia by promoting a business-led approach through strong business process knowledge, collaboration, and effective communication. A key aspect of this role is identifying and managing risk while partnering closely with Sales, Finance, and cross-functional stakeholders across Microsoft.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Supports the adoption of a Business Trust & Accountability framework and helps implement global compliance initiatives.
  
  

* Establishes and maintains the monitoring and testing framework, including controls, scope, and methodology, in partnership with program stakeholders. Reviews testing results and metrics to assess effectiveness, supports continuous improvement efforts, and promotes accountability for remediation planning and execution.
* Facilitates key monitoring processes, contributes to risk assessments, and helps ensure that appropriate controls and risk mitigation activities are implemented and operating effectively.
* Identifies and evaluates risks related to sales deal execution across customer and partner engagements and collaborates with stakeholders to implement appropriate risk management measures and controls.
* Partners with the business to support effective due diligence and oversight of third parties. Helps determine risk-based and practical control requirements and supports the timely completion of required controls in collaboration with relevant stakeholders.
* Act as the compliance manager for the EPS and GCPS segments in India & SA. Own the processes and controls that keep the partner ecosystem compliant, and give guidance on partner escalations, including offboarding partners who don't comply.
* Work with Partner Engagement Managers, Asia Partner Compliance experts and leadership to shape decisions. Make sure regional and global decisions fit India's strategy, and that India's priorities and lessons feed back into Asia and global decisions.
* Help EPS and GCPS teams own compliance themselves through the compliance champ network, partner training, and regular reviews of partner risks with senior leaders.
* Utilizes and promotes available compliance learning resources and supports the development of local compliance champions.
* Supports the implementation of compliance policies and processes through the review, development, and delivery of compliance training and awareness programs.
* Leverages AI and automation tools, where appropriate, to perform data analysis and generate actionable insights that help prioritize compliance efforts in higher-risk areas.
* Simplifies, automates, or streamlines processes to improve operational efficiency and effectiveness.
* Identifies, assesses, and addresses emerging or region-specific compliance risks.
* Supports internal audit activities and collaborates with management to develop, implement, and track remediation plans through issue resolution.

title: Responsible AI Solution Risk Assessor
description:
**Overview**
Are you passionate about advancing the positive impact of AI on a global scale? In this position, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring that our AI initiatives are implemented responsibly and effectively.
  
  
Our Trust and Integrity Protection (TrIP) team works with other parts of Microsoft to ensure we continue to be one of the most trusted companies in the world. We are seeking a detail-oriented and principled Responsible AI Solution Risk Assessor to be part of a team evaluating AI use cases across our organization. This role is critical in ensuring that AI solutions are developed and deployed in alignment with Microsoft’s Responsible AI principles, regulatory requirements, and ethical standards. You will work closely with the Office of Responsible AI and other governance bodies to identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with AI technologies.
  
  
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees, we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day, we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Risk Assessment Ownership: Lead the Responsible AI risk assessment process for AI projects within your purview.
* Use Case Evaluation: Analyze proposed AI solutions for ethical, privacy, and security risks, including identifying sensitive use cases (e.g., facial recognition, biometric analysis, or legally sensitive applications).
* Escalation Management: Determine when use cases require escalation to internal review boards such as the Deployment Safety Board or other governance entities.
* Approval Coordination: Ensure all necessary approvals are obtained before development or deal sign-off, maintaining alignment with internal Responsible AI policies.
* Documentation & Compliance: Maintain thorough documentation of risk assessments, approvals, and mitigation strategies to support audit readiness and compliance.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with product teams, legal, compliance, and engineering to ensure risk considerations are addressed early in the development lifecycle.
* Policy Integration: Translate Responsible AI policies into actionable assessment criteria and workflows.
* Continuous Improvement: Contribute to the evolution of risk assessment frameworks and tools based on emerging technologies and regulatory changes.

**Qualifications**
Required Qualifications (RQs)
  
  

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Ethics, Law, Risk Management, or a related field.
* 3+ years of experience in risk assessment, compliance, or governance roles, preferably in AI or emerging technologies.
* Familiarity with Responsible AI frameworks (e.g., NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, EU AI Act).
* Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and documentation abilities.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams in a matrixed organization.

**Preferred Qualifications (PQs)**

* Bachelor's Degree in Risk Management, Engineering, Government Intelligence, Security, or Information Technology, or related field AND 5+ years experience in Risk Management in the context of Operations, Engineering, Information Technology, Business Analyst, Consulting, Auditing, Privacy, Security, Compliance, Government Intelligence, and/or Finance OR equivalent experience.
* Experience with internal governance processes such as AI review boards or safety panels.
* Knowledge of privacy-preserving technologies and bias mitigation techniques.
* Background in regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, finance, government).
* Certifications in AI ethics, compliance, or risk management.

title: Grants Manager – Access to Justice
description:
At the Philanthropy, we make multi-year grants to not-for-profit organisations that work with the most vulnerable in our society. Through such support, people who are deeply disadvantaged and marginalised are offered immediate care, access to essential services, and the possibility of a dignified future.

**About the role**

Our efforts in Access to Justice focus on supporting organizations that enhance legal awareness among vulnerable populations regarding their rights and the constitutional framework. We also support initiatives aimed at improving the participation of vulnerable communities through various channels such as paralegalism and legal education. Additionally, a significant portion of our work is dedicated to providing legal representation for vulnerable and marginalized individuals.

**Responsibilities**

* Conduct scoping and programmatic due diligence of organisations
* Review all proposals to ensure that the required information has been provided, including the overall purpose and the journey of the organisation
* Dialogue with the partner organisation to understand effects of their engagement
* Guide the organisations in budget preparation and support the finance team with budget review and financial due diligence where required.
* Lead the grant making process for the assigned organisations and ensure compliance with the Foundation’s guidelines and requirements.
* Manage the grant management process system through the entire lifecycle of a grant.

**What we are looking for**

* Candidates who have worked with organisations providing legal aid or programmes assisting vulnerable populations through legal or government processes. While not critical, some experience with grant management, design or evaluation is desirable. Grant making in other foundations on access to justice is also a plus.
* Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree desirable
* Should have made significant and long-lasting contributions in their area of work
* High level of self-motivation, initiative, and creativity
* Willingness to travel extensively for work
* Substantial knowledge of organisational and project management
* Ability to work with minimal supervision, and solve problems independently or collaboratively as needed
* Minimum 8 - 10 years of experience in the sector

title: Manager - GRC
description:
Position Overview
  
  
D rive LeadSquared’s information security, privacy, BFSI regulatory, and AI governance compliance program. This senior, hands-on role leads audits, risk and control governance, customer assurance, policy management, evidence readiness, and cross-functional coordination across ISO 27001:2022, SOC 2 Type 2, HIPAA, GDPR, CCPA, DPDP Act, RBI, SEBI, IRDAI , and ISO/IEC 42001 .
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Compliance & audits: Own end-to-end ISO 27001:2022, SOC 2 Type 2, HIPAA, privacy, BFSI, and ISO/IEC 42001 programs, including readiness, internal audits, management reviews, external assessments, evidence, dashboards, and remediation.
* Privacy & regulatory: Operationalize GDPR, CCPA, DPDP Act, RBI, SEBI, and IRDAI requirements, including data mapping, DPIAs, ROPA , retention, cross-border transfers, localization, outsourcing, and breach notifications.
* Policy & risk governance: Maintain policies, standards, exceptions, risk registers, and assessments covering security, privacy, third parties, AWS/cloud, SDLC, DevOps, applications, and AI; track owners, mitigation, residual risk, approvals, and closure.
* AI governance: Build and improve an ISO/IEC 42001-aligned AI Management System, including use-case inventories, impact and risk assessments, responsible-AI controls, vendor reviews, human oversight, monitoring, and evidence.
* Assurance & stakeholders: Lead customer RFIs/RFPs, security and privacy questionnaires, audits, and customer discussions; coordinate Security, IT, Engineering, Product, Legal, Privacy, HR, Customer Success, auditors, and regulators.
* Operations & improvement: Oversee incident compliance, RCA/CAPA, vendor risk, awareness and phishing programs, GRC automation, regulatory tracking, control monitoring, reporting, and continuous maturity improvements; mentor team members. Perform AI driven compliance automation

**Qualifications**

* 7 –10 years in information security GRC, audit, risk, and privacy, with proven ownership of enterprise compliance programs.
* Mandatory: Multiple end-to-end ISO 27001:2022 and SOC 2 Type 2 audit cycles; privacy compliance (GDPR, CCPA, DPDP Act); BFSI regulations (RBI, SEBI, IRDAI); SDLC/DevOps and AWS risk assessments; and customer security/privacy RFI responses.
* Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10 cloud , application and AI security risks , incident management, third-party risk, and experience in GRC/compliance-automation platforms such as Sprinto , AuditBoard , Drata , etc.
* Mandatory w orking knowledge of AI governance, including lifecycle risk, data quality, monitoring, fairness, explainability, transparency, accountability, human oversight, and third-party AI risk.
* Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, or related field; Master’s preferred. Certifications such as ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Implementer, CISA, CISM, or CISSP preferred; ISO/IEC 42001 and privacy certifications are advantageous.
* Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder-management, leadership, and mentoring skills.

title: Legal Data Program Manager
description:
**Introduction**
IBM is seeking an experienced Legal Data Program Manager to serve as the primary operational lead for assigned eDiscovery, litigation, investigation, and compliance matters. Reporting to the Global eDiscovery Senior Manager, this role owns matters from intake through closeout and coordinates internal counsel, outside counsel, business stakeholders, IT, security, privacy, and service providers to deliver timely, cost-effective, and defensible outcomes.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines hands-on command of the full legal data and eDiscovery lifecycle with disciplined case management, strong judgment, and clear communication. The successful candidate will anticipate risk, maintain accurate matter records, translate legal strategy into executable workflows, and use data, technology, and vendor partnerships to improve quality, speed, transparency, and cost control across a global portfolio.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  
End-to-End Matter Management
  
  

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned matters and own execution from intake, scoping, and planning through preservation, collection, processing, review, production, and matter closeout.
* Translate legal strategy and deadlines into documented project plans, milestones, roles, dependencies, budgets, quality controls, and escalation paths.
* Lead matter kickoff calls and recurring status meetings; coordinate internal counsel, outside counsel, business units, technical teams, and service providers.
* Provide assistance with meet-and-confer preparation, ESI protocols, search-term negotiations, production specifications, and declarations or documentation concerning discovery processes.
* Maintain complete and accurate matter records, including scope decisions, chain-of-custody documentation, data maps, collection logs, exceptions, approvals, productions, and closeout records.
* Track matter health, deadlines, data volumes, review progress, risks, issues, spend, and forecast-to-complete; provide concise reporting and escalate material concerns with recommended actions.
* Conduct post-matter reviews and coordinate secure data disposition, return, or retention in accordance with legal, contractual, and IBM requirements.

Stakeholder Advisory and Case Strategy
  
  

* Advise attorneys and case teams on auditable, proportionate, and practical approaches to preservation, collection, search, review, analytics, privilege, and production.
* Assess matter complexity, data sources, jurisdictional requirements, privacy constraints, cost drivers, and technical risks; recommend an appropriate execution strategy.
* Explain technical concepts, platform capabilities, limitations, and tradeoffs to legal and non-technical audiences and convert decisions into clear operational requirements.
* Serve as a trusted advisor during high-risk or high-visibility matters, applying sound judgment and escalating issues promptly.

Technology, Analytics, and Process Improvement
  
  

* Evaluate and apply technology-assisted review, continuous active learning, advanced analytics, AI-assisted review, and other automation where appropriate, with documented objectives, validation methods, quality controls, and defensibility considerations.
* Develop repeatable workflows, templates, playbooks, and quality-assurance standards that improve consistency and scalability across matters.
* Identify operational gaps and recommend process, configuration, integration, or automation improvements based on matter data and lessons learned.
* Support the implementation, governance, adoption, and responsible use of approved eDiscovery technologies.
* Deliver practical training and guidance to attorneys, case teams, and internal partners on eDiscovery processes and tools.

**Preferred Education**
Doctorate Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
Required Professional and Technical Expertise
  
  
**Experience**

* 6+ years of eDiscovery program management experience, gained in-house, at a law firm, consultancy, or eDiscovery service provider.
* Experience managing complex global legal data and eDiscovery matters and programs.
* Deep, hands-on knowledge of the full legal data and eDiscovery lifecycle and workflows, including legal hold, preservation, collection, processing, review, production, and data disposition.
* Experience with global eDiscovery matters spanning multiple jurisdictions, data privacy regimes (e.g., GDPR), and cross-border production challenges.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent, complex matters with competing deadlines and shifting priorities.
* Significant experience interacting with and advising senior stakeholders, outside counsel, and cross-functional partners.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Hands-on proficiency with one or more leading eDiscovery platforms such as Relativity, Nuix, Reveal, or Everlaw, or comparable tools
* Experience with TAR/CAL workflows, predictive analytics, and AI-driven document review methodologies.
* Experience explaining and guiding legal teams on search algorithms, Boolean search logic, and analytics tools.
* Familiarity with modern enterprise productivity platforms and cloud-based data sources (e.g., Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Slack, Teams).
* Deep understanding of the Electronic Discovery Reference Model (EDRM) and eDiscovery industry best practices.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted review tools and a demonstrated desire to continue learning emerging AI methodologies.

Professional Skills
  
  

* Strong project and time management skills with the ability to prioritize, solve problems, and meet deadlines under pressure.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to communicate technical specifics to non-technical audiences.
* Highly organized, with strong judgment and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to quickly learn new processes and systems and apply that knowledge effectively across matters.
* Strong ethical standards and commitment to compliance.
* Ability to support global teams, including occasional flexibility outside standard business hours when needed.

**Preferred Skills**
**Preferred technical and professional experience**

* Project management or eDiscovery accreditations such as PMP, ACEDS, or RCA.

title: IT Compliance & Controls Analyst II
description:
**Description**
The IT Compliance/Controls Analyst II is a pivotal role within the Global Information Security (GIS) department, dedicated to advancing IT governance and managing organizational risk. This position ensures the robust implementation and operational effectiveness of critical IT controls. A primary focus is maintaining rigorous compliance with key global regulatory and assurance obligations, including but not limited to CFTC, SEC, Fedline Assurance, and SWIFT CSP, for independent effective challenge and minimize corporate risk. The incumbent will conduct comprehensive security risk assessments, with a specialized emphasis on evaluating AI/ML deployments and frontier model concepts. Furthermore, the role involves driving automated AI-based risk and compliance initiatives to keep the organization at the forefront of technological and process evolution.
  
  
**Primary Accountabilities**

* Internalize and contribute to the strategic goals of the CME Group Technology Compliance Team.
* Maintain expert knowledge of the company’s IT infrastructure, applications, and governance standards.
* Execute control assessments to verify the adequacy of internal controls and adherence to corporate policies.
* Conduct comprehensive security risk assessments to preemptively address audit findings and reduce risk.
* Evaluate security risks associated with AI/ML deployments and emerging frontier model technologies.
* Lead forward-looking AI-driven risk initiatives to ensure continuous alignment with regulatory advancements.
* Design and implement Python-based control automation pipelines, integrating with enterprise APIs (Archer GRC, CyberArk, AD, HashiCorp Vault) for programmatic evidence validation.
* Ensure strict compliance with regulatory obligations, including CFTC, Fedline, and SWIFT CSP frameworks.
* Produce detailed, logical work-papers documenting testing procedures, results, and expert conclusions.
* Streamline control testing and risk processes utilizing automation and AI tools (e.g., Python, Gemini).
* Foster collaborative relationships with stakeholders to enhance the efficiency of the controls testing program.

****Key responsibilities include****

* Test internal technology controls in alignment with global regulatory requirements.
* Develop and recommend strategic remediation plans for identified control gaps.
* Identify opportunities for automation within IT control and risk assessment workflows.
* Provide regular status reporting and assist in the development of performance metrics for senior leadership.
* Partner with senior team members to advise management on strengthening controls and mitigating risks.
* Assess existing controls against evolving industry best practices and legal obligations.
* Execute standard lifecycle security risk assessments across diverse technical domains.
* Proactively identify and mitigate risks associated with emerging AI/ML technologies and frontier models.
* Support the establishment and refinement of compliance frameworks for AI applications.
* Maintain strict alignment with global regulatory standards in all remediation and testing activities.

The incumbent will collaborate with key partners such as IT Control Owners, Corporate Compliance, Business Process Owners and Global Assurance (i.e. Internal Audit) with supporting and establishing new approaches or changes in existing processes around documented requirements for mitigation of associated risks. Given the current control environment, precedents will need to be established to determine how to properly respond, leveraging defined controls but continuing to establish a policy reflecting a culture of compliance.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, or a related technical field.
* 2+ years of experience in IT audit, risk advisory, or information security within a financial or professional services firm.
* Professional certification highly desirable (CISA, CISSP, CRISC, or ISO 27001).
* Experience in technical aspects of IT Risk Management, Information Security, Technical Privacy, and/or IT Audits
* Working Knowledge in technologies and environments leveraging operational knowledge of Information Security best practices and industry standards to define the security controls and processes
* Experience as an Information Security analyst in a professional services firm or large enterprise, which includes interfacing with key control stakeholders, and participating in the planning and execution of projects in one or more of the following areas - Information Security, Risk Management, Technical Compliance, IT Security Audit, Remediation, and / or IT Risk Management (or) Experience in one or more Technology areas like Information Security, Software Development, IT Architecture, RPA, Data Analytics, etc. with a willingness to move to an IT audit role.
* Proficiency in Python-based automation for continuous control monitoring and data analysis.
* Ability to recommend and implement automation solutions to enhance efficiency and effectiveness of compliance controls.
* Familiarity with AI governance frameworks (e.g., ISO 42001, EU AI Act) and best practices.
* Ability to participate in key team discussions and meetings; preparing concise, accurate documents and balancing project deadlines with the occurrence of unanticipated issues.
* Possess strong written and verbal communication skills/presentation skills, and ability to work with diverse teams
* Demonstrate thorough abilities as a team player; creating a positive environment while meeting project expectations and respecting the work-life quality of team members, providing candid, meaningful feedback in a timely manner, and keeping leadership informed of progress and issues.
* Interfacing with key stakeholders on control solutions. Participating in planning and execution of projects in: Information Security, Risk Management, Technical Privacy/Compliance, IT Security Audit, and / or IT Risk Management.
* Knowledge of industry frameworks such as NIST, COBIT, CFTC, and SOC2.
* Experience working with CAATs/data analytics tools and technologies such as Cloud, DevOps, Microservices, etc.
* Proficient usage of Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC) & Audit tools
